recipes.title: Almond Braid
recipes.instructions:
1. Place margarine and 3/4 c. sugar in 4 qt. bowl; pour heated milk over margarine.
   Uses: 1 cup margarine
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 cups warm milk

2. Mix yeast with 1/2 c lukewarm water and 1 T. sugar; stir; let stand for 5 min.
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast
   Uses: 1/2 cup lukewarm water (for yeast)
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar (for yeast)

3. Add eggs and yeast to other mixture; add salt and sifted flour; beat together with spoon-- no kneading.
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 6 cups flour

4. Cover with cloth; let rise for 1 1/2 hours in warm place.

5. Separate dough into 6 equal pieces.

6. Mix filling of butter, sugar, oats, and almond extract..
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/3 cup rolled oats
   Uses: 2 tsp almond extract

7. Roll out dough into an 8 X 10 rectangle; spread small amount of filling in center of dough.

8. On each side of rectangle make cuts 2" apart and 2"long , lace strips by alternately crossing them over; tuck ends underneath;  let rise for 30 min.

9. Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes.  Makes 6 pastries.

recipes.instructions:

recipes.instructions:
If apples lack tartness sprinkle with about 1 tablespoon lemon juice.  Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, and dash salt; mix with apples.  Line 9 inch  pie pan with pastry.  Fill with apple mixture; dot with butter.  Adjust top crust, cutting slits for escape of steam; seal.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 400 for 50 minutes or until done.

recipes.instructions:

2.  Heat remaining butter in skillet.  Rub pork with 1/4 teaspoon thyme, add to skillet sear on all sides.  Remove - add cider, cook over high heat until reduced by 1/2. Add to shortening mixture, mix just enough so dough shapes into a ball.  Roll out half to a 15x11 rectangle; transfer to a baking sheet.  Cover with cornflakes, then with apple slices.  Make sure that you have plenty of apples.  Roll out other half of dough for top crust; place over apples; pinch edges together.  Beat egg white until stiff, spread on top of crust. recipes.title: Authentic Louisiana Red Beans and Rice
recipes.description: "Authentic Cajun flavor! I grew up in Louisiana and love red beans and rice, these are just like I remember. Serve with Tabasco sauce for a little kick. My family loved to splash a little cider vinegar in each bowl."
recipes.instructions:
1. Rinse beans, and then soak in a large pot of water overnight.
2. In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Cook onion, bell pepper, garlic, and celery in olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes.
3. Rinse beans, and transfer to a large pot with 6 cups water. Stir cooked vegetables into beans. Season with bay leaves, cayenne pepper, thyme, sage, parsley, and Cajun seasoning. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
4. Stir sausage into beans, and continue to simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Meanwhile, prepare the rice. In a saucepan, bring water and rice to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve beans over steamed white rice.

recipes.title: Blondies
recipes.instructions:
Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 350 degrees.  Spray a 13 by 9 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Fold two 16 inch pieces of foil or parchment paper lengthwise so that one measures 13 inches wide and the other measures 9 inches wide.  Fit one sheet in the bottome of the greased pan pushing it into the corners and up the sides of the pan. (the overhang will help in removal of the baked bars.) Fit the second sheet in the pan in the same manner, perpendicular to the first sheet.  Spray the sheets with nonstick cooking spray.  

Whisk the flour, baking powder, and salt together in a medium bowl; set aside.

Whisk the melted butter and brown sugar together in a medium bowl until combined.  Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.  Using a rubber spatula, fold the dry ingredients into the egg mixture until just combined.  Do not overmix.  Fold in the semisweet and white chocolate chips and th enuts and turn the batter into the prepared pan, smoothing the top with a rubber spatula.

Bake until the top is shinny and cracked and feels firm to the touch, 22 to 25 minutes.  Cool completely on a wire rack.  Remove the bars from the pan using the foil or parchment handles and transfer to a cutting board.  Cut into 1 1/2 by 2 inch bars and serve.

recipes.title: Bread
recipes.instructions:
Warm milk, add butter, let cool, add 3 cups of white flour, salt and sugar, add 6 more cups flour, and eggs, dissolve yeast and add to mixture.  keep adding flour until right consistency, knead for 10 minutes.  let rest.  Pot in oiled bowl, cover and let raise double, punch down and turn over and let raise for 30 minutes, punch down, turn over,  let rest with lid off for 10 minutes.  Divide into 6 loaves, let rest 10 minutes.  Roll out and put into pans.  Raise till double.  Preheat oven 450°F.  Put in bread and turn oven down to 325°F and bake 35 min.

Personal method-  I use powdered milk and hot water.  I cook 1 cup oatmeal with 2 cups water in microwave.  When thick and cooked I place the margarine in container with oatmeal to melt margarine.  I place oatmeal, milk and margarine in bread mixer.  I then add the sugar, salt and some of the flour.  Then add the eggs and yeast.  I use instant yeast so there is no need to dissolve yeast in water, just add it directly to the bread mixture.  Add more flour (I like to use part whole wheat) until it is starts to pull away from the sides of the bosh bowl.  Let rest for 5-6 minutes.  Then start the bosh again, set timer for 10 minutes.  and add more flour until it is the right consistency.  Let knead for rest of 10 minutes.  Adding flour as needed.  When done kneading, put into an oiled bowl, cover.  Let rest until double in size.  Punch down and let rest for 30 more minutes.  Punch down, and separate into 6 loaves.  Depending on the dough I can sometime get 6 big loaves and 1 little loaf.  Let rest for 10 minutes and then roll up and put into pans.  Let raise until about 1 inch above the rim of pan.  Preheat oven to 450°F place pans in and turn down oven to 325°F and cook for 35 minutes.  Remove from pans, brush tops with butter.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Bread

ingredients.name: Wheat flour
ingredients.prep_notes: finely milled hard white wheat flour
ingredients.display_text: 5 1/2 cups Wheat flour (finely milled hard white wheat flour)

recipes.instructions:
Makes two 8" x 4" loaves 

This recipe is from The Laurel’s Kitchen Bread Book. The taste and texture are as close as you can get to “white bread” without giving up any of the nutrition of whole grain. The instructions below assume you are using a stand mixer. You can also prepare the dough with a breadmaker or by hand. 

Place 5 ½ cups finely milled hard white wheat flour and 2 teaspoons instant yeast in bowl of mixer fitted with dough hooks. 

In separate bowl, combine 1 ¼ cups buttermilk, ¾ cup hot water, ¼ cup honey, and 2 teaspoons salt. Whisk well to dissolve honey and salt. 

Turn mixer on lowest setting and slowly pour in liquids. Knead with mixer for 10 - 12 minutes. Halfway through kneading, add 3 tablespoons of butter in small pieces. The dough will be somewhat sticky, but resist the temptation to add more flour, as adding flour will make your loaf tough and dense. 

Turn dough into an ungreased bowl.  Let rise for an hour and a half or until doubled in bulk.

Gently turn risen dough onto table. Slowly press down on dough, letting air escape. Cut into two equal pieces. Sprinkle a LITTLE flour onto the table (a few tablespoons), and gently knead each piece of dough, forming each into a cylinder. 

Place a dough cylinder into each greased bread pan. Put both bread pans back into the oven that is turned off. Let rise until pans are full and bread is just barely cresting the top of the pan. 

Take pans out. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Return pans to oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until done. Turn bread out on cooling rack to cool completely. 

You can also make rolls. Recipe will make 2 dozen rolls bake for 20 minutes at 400°F.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 200 degrees. Set a wire cooling rack over a baking sheet and set aside. 

2. Whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, melted butter, and then the buttermilk. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients, pour the buttermilk mixture into the well, and whisk very gently until the buttermilk mixture is just incorporated (a few lumps should remain). Be careful not to overmix the batter. 

3. Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Brush the pan bottom with 1 teaspoon oil. Using 1/4 cup of batter per pancake, add the batter to the skillet (only 2 or 3 pancakes will fit at a time) and cook until large bubbles begin to appear, about 2 minutes. Flip the pancakes and cook until golden brown on the second side, about 1½ minutes longer. Spread the pancakes out over the wire rack on the baking sheet (they shouldn't overlap) and hold in the warm oven. Repeat with the remaining batter, brushing the skillet with oil as needed between batches.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
recipes.instructions:
In large saucepan, bring water to a simmer; add chicken breast, onion and celery.  Bring water to a boil and gently boil chicken breasts in enough water to cover for 30 minutes.  Let chicken cool in broth and remove meat from bones.  Discard skin and bones; reserve broth for another use.Steam broccoli until just barely cooked and bright green.Preheat oven to 350°.  Make sauce by combining soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.In 9x13 casserole, place broccoli on bottom, then top with chicken or visa versa which ever you like.  Cover with sauce, then cheese, and bread crumbs.Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly. 

Note:  Instead of using cream of chicken soup, you can make your own sauce.  Make a roux by melting 3 tablespoons butter and stirring in 2 tablespoons flour and cooking it 3 minutes until golden.  Then whisk in 1 1/2 cups milk and 1 1/2 cups chicken broth seasoned with salt and pepper, cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.  Spray skillet with nonstick spray and cook chicken over medium-high heat until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  Place in large bowl and set aside.  When cooked, add 1 cup salsa, 1/2 cup sour cream and 1 cup cheese.  Spray skillet again and add onion.  Saute over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes, adding chicken broth as needed to keep the onions from browning.  Add garlic, cumin and chili powder, then tomatoes, tomato sauce and the rest of the chicken broth.  Bring to boil, then lower heat, cover pan and cook about 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray 9-by-13 inch pan with nonstick spray and set aside.  Dip tortillas, one at a time, in tomato mixture and place about 1/3 cup chicken filling in each one, rolling up and placing seam side down in prepared pan.  Add remaining sour cream to sauce and pour over enchiladas in pan.  Sprinkle remaining 1/3 cup cheese over top, and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until heated through.

recipes.instructions:
Prepare the sauce.  Sauce - 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 Tbsp. soy sauce, 2 Tbsp rice vinegar, 2 Tbsp ketchup, 1 Tbsp, lemon juice, 1 Tbsp chinese hot mustard, 1 - 3 tsp. garlic chili paste, 1/8 tsp. sesame oil. Cover mushrooms with boiling water and let stand for 30 minutes. 

Combine hoisin sauce, soy sauce, 1 Tbsp apple juice, oyster sauce, 2 Tbsp. water, sesame oil, sugar and 2 tsp. cornstarch; set aside.

  In a medium bowl, combine remaining 1 tsp. cornstarch, 2 tsp apple juice, 2 tsp. water, salt and pepper; lay chicken into mixture and spoon over to coat.  Stir in 1 tsp vegetable oil and let sit 15 minutes to marinate. 

 Heat a wok or large skillet over medium high hear; stir - fry chicken in 3 Tbsp. vegetable oil for 3 - 4 minutes; remove from wok/pan chop chicken and set aside.

Eat and and enjoy.  This is good with cellophane noodles, grated carrots, and sliced cucumbers ( that have marinated in apple cider vinegar for a few minutes).

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.instructions:
Fill pot with 1 quart water.   Wash and cut up chicken and onion.  Add to water, onion, 2 celery stalks, and 5 chicken bouillon.  Bring to a boil and then add cut up chicken.  Boil until chicken is done.   Remove chicken and let cool.

Strain broth and remove the chicken fat that has settled on top of broth.

Make more broth by adding more water and bouillon or by adding canned chicken broth or soup base.  I personally like the soup base.  Taste broth and add salt, pepper and extra soup base until it tastes right.  Have about 2 quarts broth total.  Bring to boil and add either homemade noodles, frozen or dry noodles.  Homemade and frozen are best, dry is last resort.  Add cut up chicken and cook until noodles are done.   Serve with hot homemade french bread.

When making final broth grated carrots and diced celery add extra flavor.   This is a family favorite especially on a cold day.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
recipes.instructions: In a large heavy saucepan cook the mushrooms in 1/4 cup of the butter over moderate hear, stirring, until most of the liquid they give off has evaporated, stir in the flour, and cook the mixture over low heat, stirring, for 3 minutes.  Add in a stream the milk, broth, and the white grape juice, stirring, bring the mixture to a boil,  simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.  In a kettle of boiling salted water cook the spaghetti until it is al dente and drain it well.In a large bowl combine the spaghetti, mushroom sauce, chicken,  peas, and salt and pepper to taste, stir in 1/3 cup of the parmesan, and transfer the mixture to a buttered shallow 3-quart casserole.  In a small bowl combine the remaining  1/3 cup parmesan, the bread crumbs and salt and pepper to taste, sprinkle the mixture evenly over the tetrazzine, and dot the top with the remaining1 tablespoon butter, cut into bits.  The tetrazzini may be prepared up to this point in advance and kept frozen, covered.  Bake the tetrazzini in the middle of a preheated 375° oven for 30-40 minutes, or until it is bubbling and the top is golden.  Tip - If you have a child that doesn't like mushrooms just take and blend the mushroom sauce so that they don't know that there are any mushrooms in the casserole. recipes.instructions:
Chicken Tikka
1/2teaspoon ground cumin
1/2teaspoon ground coriander
1/4teaspoon cayenne pepper
1teaspoon table salt
2pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts , trimmed of fat
1cup plain whole-milk yogurt
2tablespoons vegetable oil
2medium garlic cloves , minced or pressed through a garlic press (about 2 teaspoons)
1tablespoon grated fresh ginger
(This dish is best when prepared with whole-milk yogurt, but low-fat yogurt can be substituted)

1. FOR THE CHICKEN: Combine cumin, coriander, cayenne, and salt in small bowl. Sprinkle both sides
of chicken with spice mixture, pressing gently so mixture adheres. Place chicken on plate, cover with
plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes. In large bowl, whisk together yogurt, oil, garlic, and
ginger; set aside.
2. FOR THE SAUCE: Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion and
cook, stirring frequently, until light golden, 8 to 10 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, chile, tomato paste, and
garam masala; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add crushed tomatoes, sugar, and
salt; bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cream and return to simmer. Remove pan from heat and cover to keep warm.
3. While sauce simmers, adjust oven rack to upper-middle position (about 6 inches from heating element)
and heat broiler. Using tongs, dip chicken into yogurt mixture (chicken should be coated with thick layer
of yogurt) and arrange on wire rack set in foil-lined rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan. Discard excess
yogurt mixture. Broil chicken until thickest parts register 160 degrees on instant-read thermometer and
exterior is lightly charred in spots, 10 to 18 minutes, flipping chicken halfway through cooking.
4. Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then cut into 1-inch chunks and stir into warm sauce (do not simmer
chicken in sauce). Stir in cilantro, adjust seasoning with salt, and serve.

Step-by-Step: Chicken Tikka Masala

1. RUB: Coat chicken in salt and spice mixture and refrigerate.
2. MAKE SAUCE: Prepare creamy tomato-masala sauce.
3. DIP: Dunk chicken in protective coating of yogurt and oil.
4. BROIL: Broil chicken, then allow to rest.
5. COMBINE: Cut chicken into chunks and add to sauce.Step-by-Step: Key Ingredients for

Garam Masala: This combination of warm spices seasons the masala sauce. McCormick won a recent test
kitchen tasting.

Plain Yogurt: Whole-milk yogurt forms a protective barrier on the chicken. Brown Cow is our favorite
brand.

Crushed Tomatoes: Crushed tomatoes form the base of the masala sauce. Muir Glen was highly rated in a
recent tasting.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl Pancakes

ingredients.name: packed light brown sugar
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup + 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar

recipes.instructions:
Prepare the cinnamon filling: In a medium bowl, stir together the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon. Scoop the filling into a quart-sized heavy zip baggie and set it aside (see *Tips below).

Prepare the glaze: In a small pan, heat the butter over low heat until melted. Turn off the heat and whisk in the cream cheese until it is almost smooth. Sift the powdered sugar into the pan, stir and add in vanilla extract. Set the pan aside while you make the pancakes.

Prepare the pancake batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt. Whisk in the milk, egg and oil, just until the batter is moistened (a few small lumps are fine).

Cook the pancakes: Heat a large, nonstick skillet over medium-heat and spray with nonstick spray. Use an ice cream scoop (or 1/3 cup measuring cup) to add the batter to the pan. Use the bottom of the scoop or cup to spread the batter into a circle (about 4-inches in diameter). Reduce the heat to medium low. Snip the corner of your baggie of cinnamon filling and squeeze the filling into the open corner. When your pancake begins to form bubbles, add the filling. Starting at the center of the pancake, squeeze the filling on top of the pancake batter in a swirl (just as you see in a regular cinnamon roll). Cook the pancake 2 to 3 minutes, or until the bubbles begin popping on top of the pancake and it's golden brown on the bottom. Slide a thin, wide metal spatula underneath the pancake and gently but quickly flip it over. Cook an additional 2 to 3 minutes, until the other side is golden as well. When you flip the pancake onto a plate, you will see that the cinnamon filling has created a crater-swirl of cinnamon. Wipe out the pan with a paper towel, and repeat with the remaining pancake batter and cinnamon filling. Re-warm the glaze briefly, if needed. Serve pancakes topped with a drizzle of glaze.

    Whisk together the remaining milk and the flour until smooth, and whisk the milk mixture into the hot stock mixture. Keep whisking continuously to avoid lumps until the soup comes almost to a boil and thickens.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken
recipes.instructions: Melt butter; add flour and stir until smooth.  Combine remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture.  Stir until thickened over low hear.  Add chicken.  Server over rice, noodles or frozen Pepperidge Farm patty shells.

recipes.title: Creamed Corn
recipes.instructions: Melt butter  with corn. Add 2/3 cup water and boil. Simmer for 10 mins. Add cream, sugar and cornstarch.

recipes.title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
recipes.instructions: In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients; bring to the boiling point. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes or until noodles are tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Jumbo Drops
recipes.instructions: Cream, mix, bake, 350°F.

recipes.title: Creamy Vegetables
recipes.instructions: Peel carrots and slice into thin carrot sticks.  Cut broccoli into small bite size pieces.  Slice onions very thin.  Cook in pressure cooker until pressure just begins to build.  Or steam until just barely done.  Drain vegetables and place in a 9x13 dish..  .Sauce.  Melt butter add flour and stir well.  Add milk and cook until thickened.  Add salt and softened cream cheese.  Pour over vegetables then sprinkle with grated cheese and then bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Crepes
recipes.instructions:
In bowl or blender, combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.  Lightly
grease a 6-inch skillet.  Heat.  Remove from heat; spoon in about 2
tablespoons batter.  Spread batter evenly. Return to heat; brown on one
side, turn over and brown other side

recipes.title: Crispy, Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper.Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.  In a medium bowl, cream together the melted butter, brown sugar and white sugar until well blended.Beat in the vanilla, egg and egg yolk until light and creamy.  Mix in the sifted ingredients until just blended.Stir in the chocolate chips by hand using a wooden spoon.  Drop cookie dough 1/4 cup at a time (for giant cookies) or a tablespoon at a time (for smaller cookies) onto the prepared cookie sheets.  Cookies should be about 3 inches apart.Bake larger cookies for 15 to 17 minutes, or 10 to 12 minutes for smaller ones (check your cookies before they're done; depending on your scoop size, your baking time will vary) in the preheated oven, or until the edges are lightly toasted.  Cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool.

recipes.title: Crown Jewel Jello

ingredients.name: jello - line
ingredients.display_text: 4 3 oz package jello - line (cherry orange lemon)

recipes.instructions: Prepare the first three flavors of Jell-O using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water.  Pour each flavor into a 8" square pan and chill until very firm.  Then combine the lemon Jell-O, sugar and 1 cup boiling water.  Stir until dissolved completely.  Put in pineapple juice.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Then cut all the Jell-O into small squares.  Blend cool whip with lemon Jell-O mixture.  Put cubes in and chill 3-4 hours.

recipes.title: Curried Carrot Soup

ingredients.name: pounds carrots
ingredients.prep_notes: scrubbed but unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds
ingredients.display_text: 2 pounds carrots (scrubbed but unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds)

ingredients.name: plain nonfat yogurt or light coconut milk
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt or light coconut milk (optional)

recipes.instructions:
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and garlic and cover. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is golden, about 5 minutes. Add the carrots and stir well. Stir in the curry powder and ginger and cook, stirring almost constantly, for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low and partially cover the pot. Simmer until the carrots are very tender, about 30 minutes.
In batches, transfer the soup to a blender, process until smooth and pour the puréed soup into a large bowl. (If you have an immersible hand blender, you can purée the soup right in the pot.) Return the puréed soup to the pot. If desired, stir in the yogurt or coconut milk and stir over low heat just until the soup is very hot; do

recipes.title: Date Pinwheels
recipes.instructions: Combine dates, raisins, sugar, water in pan; cook over low heat till thick and add the nuts and cool.  Cream shortening, sugar, add eggs.  Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture, mix well.  Chill thoroughly.  Divide the mixture into 2 parts, roll out to rectangles little less than 1/2" thick.  Spread each with some date filling and roll as for jelly roll into two long rolls.  Chill again over night, if possible. Cut with sharp knife or thread.  Bake at 375° till light brown around edges.

recipes.title: Doug's Chilli

ingredients.name: water drained form boiled pinto beans
ingredients.display_text: 30 oz water drained form boiled pinto beans

recipes.instructions:
Brown ground chuck with next three ingredients.  When brown, add the next 8 ingredients.  Simmer 30 minutes before adding remaining ingredients.  Simmer about 3 hours before serving.

 Boil beans to make pinto bean water but don't use the beans for chili, use it for something else.  True Texas chili doesn't have beans in it.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
recipes.instructions: In a 9x13 inch pan layer the pineapple, pie filling, cake mix, and nuts.  Melt butter and drizzle over top.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve hot or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Eclairs
recipes.instructions:
Boil water, add butter until melted.  Add flour all at once, cook stirring vigorously until mixture forms ball around spoon (only takes a minute).  Take off heat, cool 2 to 3 minutes.  Add eggs 1 at a time, beating vigorously after each addition.  After last egg is added beat until shiny and smooth.  Drop by spoonful shaped to long oval.  onto greased cookie sheet.  Bake 450° for 10 minutes, 325° last 10 minutes.  When cool split and add chilled pudding.  Frost with chocolate frosting, chill.

Hint-  Pudding taste better is some cool whip or whipped cream is added.  Use cooked pudding - it tastes better.

recipes.title: Edamame Salad

ingredients.name: (1 pound) package frozen shelled edamame
ingredients.display_text: 1 (1 pound) package frozen shelled edamame ((green soybeans))

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can black beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans (rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
1.	In a large serving bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, grapeseed oil, cilantro, lime juice, sugar, salt and garlic. Set aside.
2.	Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the soybeans and boil for 3 minutes. Add corn to the boiling water and continue cooking for 1 more minute. Drain very well, and pour into the bowl with the dressing. Gently mix in the cherry tomatoes, green onions and black beans. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to chill and blend the flavors.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, stir together the flour and salt. Add the beaten egg, milk, and butter. Knead dough until smooth, about 5 minutes. Let rest in a covered bowl for 10 minutes.
   2. On a floured surface, roll out to 1/8 or 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired lengths and shapes.
   3. Allow to air dry before cooking.
   4. To cook fresh pasta, in a large pot with boiling salted water cook until al dente.

recipes.title: Eggplant Curry

ingredients.name: ginger garlic paste
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste ((or make some))

recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
    Place eggplant on a medium baking sheet. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender. Remove from heat, cool, peel, and chop.
    Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Mix in cumin seeds and onion. Cook and stir until onion is tender.
    Mix ginger garlic paste, curry powder, and tomato into the saucepan, and cook about 1 minute. Stir in yogurt. Mix in eggplant and jalapeno pepper, and season with salt. Cover, and cook 10 minutes over high heat. Remove cover, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking about 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro to serve.

recipes.title: Elsie's Smoked Beans and Meat
recipes.instructions: Put in a crock pot and heat.  If more liquid is needed add green bean juice or water.  Great for cold days.

recipes.title: Elsie's Fudge
recipes.instructions:
Put all ingredients into heavy sauce pan, stir thoroughly before putting over heat.  This helps to keep the cream from curdling.  Bring to boil and wash down the sides by putting on a lid for a minute or two.  Stir to keep from burning.  Cook to 232°F pour out onto cold wet slab.  Allow to cool until neither hot or cold.  stir unto set up.  As soon as candy sets up add nuts and flavoring.  Leave out chocolate and add vanilla for vanilla fudge.  

To make frosting.  Use 4 cup sugar 1 cup 1/2 and 1/2, 1/2 cup cream 2 T. Karo, 2 T. butter, 2 sq. chocolate.Stir to boil, put on lid for 3 min.  Wash down side with wet paper towel.  Bring to 232°F cool, stir.  Micro low to melt and frost.

recipes.title: Elsie's Rolls
recipes.instructions: Warm milk, add eggs, oil.  Dissolve yeast in water.  Add to milk, stir in 3 to 4 cups. flour, beat till smooth.  Stir in rest.  (Secret of good rolls is to keep rolls as soft as possible and still be able to knead them.)Let rest 10 min.  Knead for at least 10 min. more if necessary.  Let rise in warm place til double in bulk.  Punch down, let rise again for 30 min.  Roll out on floured board, shape as you please.  Let rise until double.  Bake at 375.This dough is very versatile, it makes wonderful cinnamon rolls, orange rolls or can also be refrigerated and used later.

recipes.title: English Toffee
recipes.instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips, in a heavy saucepan; cook at medium heat until mixture turns brown in color.  Spread quickly on cookie sheet cool slightly,  put chips on top and spread until candy is coated.  Cook and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Cabbage

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.display_text: 5 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

recipes.instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the carrots and onion in the hot oil about 5 minutes. Stir in the salt, pepper, cumin, turmeric, and cabbage and cook another 15 to 20 minutes. Add the potatoes; cover. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until potatoes are soft, 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Everyday Waffles
recipes.instructions: Sift together dry ingredients.  Combine yolks, milk and oil; stir into dry ingredients.  Fold in whites, leaving a few fluffs.  Bake.  Makes 3 10-inch waffles.

recipes.title: Fajita or Nacho Marinade
recipes.instructions:
To prepare the steak: Combine olive oil, lime juice, garlic, chipotle peppers, and cilantro in the bowl of a food processor or a blender. Blend until totally combined. Place flank steak into a large plastic bag or baking dish. Pour in marinade and make sure it adequately coats the meat. Seal bag or cover tightly and refrigerate for 24 hours at least.

When ready to make the nachos, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat an outdoor grill or an indoor grill pan (or you can use a skillet). Drizzle a little olive oil on the grill and grill the meat over very high heat, about 4 minutes per side. (Turn 45 degrees halfway through on both sides to get nifty grill marks.) Remove steak from grill and set aside to rest.

In a large skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add onions and peppers and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, or until vegetables are somewhat soft and starting to get black bits. Remove from heat and set aside.

Slice half of the flank steak into strips against the grain, then chop slices into smaller bites. Place sauteed veggies on a cutting board and roughly chop to get them into smaller pieces.

Arrange tortilla chips on a large ovenproof platter (or cookie sheet.) Sprinkle plenty of cheese all over the top. Place platter in oven for 3 minutes or so, just long enough to melt the cheese (but not burn the chips.) Remove from oven, then generously sprinkle peppers, onions, and chopped steak all over the top. Return to oven for no more than another minute—just long enough to heat up the meat and peppers (but not cook the meat all the way through.)

Remove from oven and plop guacamole all over the top. Serve immediately with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Fajitas
recipes.instructions: Make a marinade of all the ingredients and soak the steak, covered in the refrigerator about 1 hour.  Meanwhile, make a charcoal fire outside (or use cast iron skillet method).When meat is ready to be cooked, slice it into about 6-inch pieces and grill quickly, turning once, no more than 3-4 minutes to the side.  Cut on the diagonal into thin strips and fold into a warm flour tortilla with sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallio.

recipes.title: Famous Chocolate Cake
recipes.instructions:
To make sour milk, put 2 tablespoons lemon juice in milk.  Let stand 5 minutes.

Put all ingredients, except boiling water, in large bowl.  Mix until barely moistened.  Add boiling water and mix until smooth.  Pour into 9 X 13 inch pan.  Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: French Bread
recipes.instructions: Dissolve 1/2 warm water with 2T. yeast. Put in large bowl;water, sugar, salt and oil. Add 3 cups flour, beat well.  Add: yeast mixture, beat well.  Add 3 cups flour.  Beat well, use a spoon.   Leave in bowl.  Let rest 10 min.  Beat down with spoon.  Repeat  5 times.  On the 5th time divide dough into two parts.  Roll out into a 12-14" rectangle.  Roll up like jelly roll.  Put on oiled cookie sheet with seam side down.  Let rise 30 min.  Bake 375°F for 30 min.   Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Frog Eye Salad
recipes.instructions: Combine sugar, flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  Gradually stir in pineapple juice and eggs.  Cook over moderate heat, stirring until thickened.  Add lemon juice.  Cool mixture to room temperature.  Bring water, remaining 2 teaspoons salt and oil to boil.  Add acini di pepe.  Cook at a rolling boil until acini de pepe is done.  Drain acini de pepe, rinse with water, drain again and cool to room temperature.  Combine egg mixture and acini de pepe.  Mix lightly but thoroughly.  Refrigerate overnight in airtight container.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix lightly but thoroughly.  Refrigerate until chilled in airtight container.  Salad may be refrigerated for as long as a week in airtight container.

recipes.title: Frozen Hot Chocolate
recipes.instructions:
Chop the chocolate into small pieces. Place it in the top of a double boiler over simmering water. Stir occasionally until melted. Add the hot chocolate mix and sugar. Stir until completely melted. Remove from heat and slowly add ½ cup of milk until smooth. Cool to room temperature.

In a blender, place the remaining cup of milk, the room-temperature chocolate mixture and the ice. Blend on high speed until smooth and the consistency of a frozen daiquiri. Pour into a giant goblet and top with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
recipes.instructions: Mix the two above together until smooth.  Serve with any fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
recipes.instructions:
Spread a 1/4 inch thick layer of cookie dough in large cookie sheet. Bake until light brown.  Cool.Mix sugar, cream cheese, vanilla, and cool whip.  Spread over cookie and cover with favorite fruit.

Ideas.   Kiwi, strawberries, blueberries, pineapple, peaches.

recipes.title: Fry Bread
recipes.instructions: Mix ingredients.  Roll very flat; cut into squares and fry with a little oil in a frying pan.  Shake in sugar and enjoy.

recipes.title: Fudgesicle

ingredients.name: vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.display_text: 1 small package vanilla pudding mix (not instant)

ingredients.name: chocolate pudding mix
ingredients.display_text: 1 small package chocolate pudding mix (not instant)

recipes.instructions: Cook for about 10 minutes until mix is slightly thickened.  Cool, place in fudgesicle molds and freeze.

recipes.title: Ganache
recipes.instructions: Melt butter add cream bring to almost a boil.Pour over chocolate sit for about 5 minutes and wisk.Amy used milk chocolate but semi sweet or bitter sweet also are wonderful.

recipes.title: German Apple Pancake
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400°F.  Spray small oval baker with nonstick cooking spray.  For apple filling, peel, core and slice apples.  Melt butter over medium heat.  Add apple, brown sugar and cinnamon.  Cook 20 minutes or until apple is tender and most of liquid has evaporated.Meanwhile, for pancake, combine flour, sugar and salt in bowl.  Whisk together eggs, milk and melted butter.  Add egg mixture to flour mixture; whisk until dry ingredients are moistened.  Pour batter over apples in oval baker.  Bake 20 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.

I cook apples in a iron skillet and then just mix the batter all together in a blender and pour over apples and bake in skillet.  When done flip onto a plate and sprinkle with powered sugar and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: (1 ounce) squares German sweet chocolate or 1 cup
ingredients.display_text: 4 (1 ounce) squares German sweet chocolate or 1 cup

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour 3 - 9 inch round pans. Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a small saucepan, heat water and 4 ounces chocolate until melted. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
   2. In a large bowl, cream 1 cup butter and 2 cups sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in 4 egg yolks one at a time. Blend in the melted chocolate mixture and vanilla. Beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk, mixing just until incorporated.
   3. In a large glass or metal mixing bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold 1/3 of the whites into the batter, then quickly fold in remaining whites until no streaks remain.
   4. Pour into 3 - 9 inch pans Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Allow to cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto wire rack.
   5. To make the Filling: In a saucepan combine 1 cup sugar, evaporated milk, 1/2 cup butter, and 3 egg yolks. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in coconut, pecans and vanilla. Cool until thick enough to spread.
   6. Spread filling between layers and on top of cake. In a small saucepan, melt shortening and 1 ounce of chocolate. Stir until smooth and drizzle down the sides of the cake.

recipes.title: German Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Combine flour, salt, eggs and milk.  Heat oven to 425°F.  Place the butter or margarine in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan in oven.  When butter is melted, pour the flour mixture over it.  Do not stir.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Or until brown.  Cut and serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Ginger Glazed Mahi Mahi
recipes.instructions:
1. In a shallow glass dish, stir together the honey, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, ginger, garlic and olive oil. Season fish fillets with salt and pepper, and place them into the dish. If the fillets have skin on them, place them skin side down. Cover, and refrigerate for 20 minutes to marinate.
   2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove fish from the dish, and reserve marinade. Fry fish for 4 to 6 minutes on each side, turning only once, until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove fillets to a serving platter and keep warm.
   3. Pour reserved marinade into the skillet, and heat over medium heat until the mixture reduces to a glaze consistently. Spoon glaze over fish, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
recipes.instructions: Combine flour, sugar, ginger, cinnamon - cut in butter, add egg.  Stir in molasses.  Dissolve soda and salt in buttermilk add to mixture.  Reserve 1/4 cup for topping.Bake 350° in a greased 9 inch square pan for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Gingerbread House
recipes.instructions:
Cream sugar, butter.  Add rest and roll 1/4 in. thick.  Cut into shapes and bake.   Make 15 min at 350°F.  Take out after 10 minutes to place crushed lifesavers for windows. Easier to roll out in large cookie sheet, cut and then remove excess.  Bake.

Use royal frosting for glue to hold it all together.

Candy used in 2001- small sixlets package, pez, gum drops( big and little), M&M's (big and little),1 pkg. chicklets, 2 -fruit stripe gum, cinnamon bears, tootsie rolls, Brach carmel logs, Christmas runts,1-whoppers (small package), gummy bears, 1 small nerds, 1 small spree, peppermint rounds, candy canes, licorice rope, life savers, 1 chocolate kiss, 1 peanut butter cup, 3- 3 musketeer bars, 3 rolls necco Wafers, necco mint patties, 1 pkg Starburst, ice cream sugar cones, sprinkles, green rings-gummy, Wafers, 2 chocolate Santa, 2 chocolate snowmen.

recipes.title: Girl Scout Cookies - Thin Mints
recipes.instructions:
Chocolate Cookie Wafers

1. Combine the cookie ingredients in a large bowl, adding the

 water a little bit at a time until the dough forms.  Cover 

and chill for 2 hours.

2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

3.  On a lightly floured surface, roll out a portion of the dough

 to just under 1/16 of an inch thick.  To cut, use a lid from a 

spice container with a 1 1/2-inch diameter (Schilling brand is good.)

  Arrange the cut dough rounds on a cookie sheet that is sprayed with

 a light coating on non-stick spray.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Remove 

the wafers from the oven and cool completely.

4.  Combine chocolate chips with peppermint extract and shortening

 in a large microwave - safe glass or ceramic bow.  Heat on 50 

percent power for 2 minutes, stir gently, then heat for an addition

 minute.  Stir once again, and if chocolate is not a smooth

 consistency, continue to zap in microwave in 30-second intervals 

until smooth.

5.  Use a fork to dip each wafer in the chocolate, tap the fork on

 the edge of the bowl so that the excell chocolate runs off, and 

then place the cookies side-by-side on a wax paper - lined baking 

sheet.  Refrigerate until firm.

Makes 108 cookies.

recipes.title: Gnocchi with Tomato Basil
recipes.instructions:
Heat oven to 475
Heat oil in ovensafe skillet until simmering. cook gnocchi, stirring, until lightly browned (4 mins) Transfer to plate

Cook onion until soft (3min)stir in garlic and pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds. Stir in Tomatoes and water and cook until slightly thickened about 5 mins

Add bail and Gnocchi to pan. Reduce heat to low and simmer stirring occasionally until gnocchi is tender (5-7 mins). Sprinkle with Mozzarella and bake until cheese is well browned - about 8 mins. ( or do not put in oven and just stir until  melted)

recipes.title: Golden Anniversary Punch

ingredients.name: frozen orange juice concentrate
ingredients.display_text: 1 6 oz can frozen orange juice concentrate

recipes.instructions: Add water to frozen concentrates according to directions on cans.  (If frozen pineapple juice is unavailable, use 1 large can of pineapple juice.)  Add Chilled apricot nectar and lemon juice.  Just before serving, spoon in sherbet.  To keep carbonation, carefully pour ginger ale down the side of the bowl.

recipes.title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
recipes.instructions:
Cut chicken into 1 x 1 pieces.  Mix egg, water, salt, and flour.  Dip chicken into batter.  Pour corn oil into pan.  Carefully add chicken, fry 3-5 min. or until golden brown.  Drain.  Serve with barbecue sauce, LaChoy Sweet & Sour Sauce or nippy pineapple sauce.

NIPPY PINEAPPLE SAUCEMix 1/2c. pineapple preserves, 2 T. prepared mustard and 2 T. horseradish in saucepan.  Cook 3 min.  Makes 3/4 cup.

recipes.title: Good H2o
recipes.instructions: Mix together in punch bowl. Add ice.  For decoration; slice lemons and float slices on top.

recipes.title: Granola

ingredients.prep_notes: tablespoons pure maple syrup or honey

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 250°F.

2. Pour all ingredients except cacao nibs in a large bowl and stir well.

3. Spread the mixture evenly onto a baking sheet in a thin layer.

4. Place the baking pan in the oven and bake for 15 minutes.

5. Remove pan from oven, toss granola around, rotate the pan, and bake for another 15 minutes. Repeat until granola is completely dry and light golden brown (about 1 hour total).

6. Allow to cool and then stir in cacao nibs. Store in an air-tight container.

recipes.title: Granola Bars

ingredients.name: to 3/4 cup granulated sugar
ingredients.prep_notes: (use more for a sweetness akin to most purchased bars; use less
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 to 3/4 cup granulated sugar ((use more for a sweetness akin to most purchased bars; use less)

ingredients.name: oat flour
ingredients.prep_notes: (or 1/3 cup oats, processed till finely ground in a food process
ingredients.display_text: 1/3 cup oat flour ((or 1/3 cup oats, processed till finely ground in a food process)

ingredients.name: to 3 cups dried fruits and nuts and or puffed grai
ingredients.display_text: 2 to 3 cups dried fruits and nuts and or puffed grai ((total of 10 to 15 ounces)*)

ingredients.name: peanut butter or another nut butter optional)
ingredients.display_text: 1/3 cup peanut butter or another nut butter optional)

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup honey (maple syrup or corn syrup)

recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line an 8? x 8? x 2? pan in one direction with parchment paper, allowing it to go up the opposing sides. Lightly grease the parchment paper and the exposed pan, or coat with a non-stick spray.
Stir together all the dry ingredients, including the fruit and nuts. In a separate bowl, whisk together the vanilla, melted butter or oil, liquid sweeteners and water. Toss the wet ingredients with the dry (and peanut butter, if you’re using it) until the mixture is evenly crumbly. Spread in the prepared pan, pressing them in firmly to ensure they are molded to the shape of the pan. (A piece of plastic wrap can help with this, as you press down on the back of it.)
Bake the bars for 30 to 40 minutes, until they’re brown around the edges — don’t be afraid to get a little color on the tops too. They’ll still seem soft and almost underbaked when you press into the center of the pan but do not worry, they’ll set completely once completely cool.
Cool the bars in their pan completely on a cooling rack. (Alternately, after about 20 minutes you can use your parchment “sling” to lift and remove the bars, and place them in their paper on the rack to cool the rest of the way. This can speed the process up.)
Once cool, a serrated knife (or bench knife) to cut the bars into squares. [Updating to note, as many had crumbling issues:] If bars seem crumbly, chill the pan of them further in the fridge for 30 minutes which will fully set the “glue”, then cut them cold. To store, wrap the bars individually in plastic or stack them in an airtight container. In humid weather, it’s best to store bars in the refrigerator. They also freeze well.
*Suggestions: Dried cranberries, apricots, pecans, sunflower seeds, coconut, walnuts, sesame seeds, pepitas, drieda pples or even chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Great Lasagna
recipes.instructions: Brown meat.  Spoon off fat.  Add next 5 ingredients.  Simmer uncovered 30 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Cook noodles, drain, rinse.  Beat egg until foamy; add remaining ingredients except mozzarella.  Layer 1/3 noodles in a 9x13 pan, 1/3 cottage cheese, 1/3 mozzarella cheese, 1/3 meat sauce.  Repeat ending with sauce then sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.  Bake 375°F 1 hour.  If assemble before and refrigerated, bake 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Green Smoothie

A couple of additional tips...wash all your greens and fruits really well. You can also use frozen fruit like your bananas that have started to turn brown, just peel them and toss them in a freezer bag for smoothies later. The soaked/sprouted almonds should be soaked at least 24 hours but no longer than 48 hours; rinsing and changing their soaking water morning and night each day. They can then be stored in the fridge for about 4 days or dehydrate them (under 115) for 24hours and they keep longer.
Also an additional note on almonds. The almonds you buy commercially from a store may say "raw" but they have actually been pasteurized. The stores are required to sell pasteurized almonds due to a congressional law against selling raw foods. (thank you congress) so you need to seek out a source that actually purchases true "raw" almonds from the almond growers. Almonds are an amazing food and worth the effort to locate raw ones!!

recipes.title: Guiltless Alfredo Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Place milk, cream cheese, flour, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth.  In a non-stick sauce pan, melt butter on med-high heat and add garlic. Let the garlic saute for about 30 seconds, you don’t want to burn it.

 2. Then add milk mixture to the pan. Stir constantly for about 3 or 4 minutes or until it just comes to a simmer. Keep stirring and let it cook for a few minutes more. It should be much thicker now.

3. When it’s nice and thickened remove the pan from the heat. Add the cheese, stir it up and then cover immediately. Let stand for at least 10 minutes before using. It will continue to thicken upon standing. Also, if you have leftovers in the fridge, the sauce will thicken almost into a solid. Just re-heat and add a little milk and it will be back to normal again.

recipes.title: Habaneros Pickles
recipes.instructions: slice pickes, combine all but garlic and 5 habaneros, put pickle mixture in jar with garlic and let sit for 3 weeks. Use left over juice to moisten next batch.

recipes.title: Hamburger Potato Casserole
recipes.instructions: Peel and thinly, slice potatoes.  Brown hamburger, season.  Grease a 2 quart baking dish, dust lightly with garlic powder.  Alternate thin layers of potatoes, onion and hamburger, ending with hamburger; season each layer.  Mix soup with milk.  Pour over potatoes.  Bake at 375°F for 1  to 1 1/2 hour, or till done.  Ten Minutes before removing from oven, sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
recipes.instructions: Fill large pot with 3 quarts of water, add 2 teaspoon salt.  Bring to boil, add the noodles.  Cook until noodles are done, drain.  While noodles are cooking start the hamburger to brown.Brown hamburger, add onions and cook until they are transparent.  Add cream of mushroom soup, cook for 5 minutes.  Add sour cream and serve over noodles

recipes.title: Hawaiian Delight Cake
recipes.instructions:
Beat cream cheese with 1/2 cup of the milk.  Add rest of milk and then pudding mix; beat and spread over cooled cake.  Chill 30 minutes.  Drain juice completely from pineapple.  Put on top of pudding.  Add whipped cream to cool whip and blend together.  Spread over tip of cake and sprinkle with coconut.  

Make cake according to package directions and bake at 350°F in 12 x 16 inch pan for 15-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hamburger Casserole
recipes.instructions: Brown hamburger, seasoning with salt, pepper, garlic powder and sugar.  Add tomato sauce, and onions and simmer 15 minutes.  Cook noodles; drain.  Cream together cream cheese and sour cream.  Layer meat mix, cheese mixture, noodles, three times and top with shredded cheese.  Bake 350°F for 20-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Vanilla Pudding

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.prep_notes: ( You can use all milk, but I like to use at least part cream fo
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup cream (( You can use all milk, but I like to use at least part cream fo)

recipes.instructions:
Combine sugar, salt, and cornstarch in a saucepan.
    Whisk in cream, milk, and egg yolks, Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly for 3-5 minutes or until thickened.
    Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and butter. Whisk until butter is melted.
    Strain through a fine mesh sieve to remove any lumps.
    Cover with plastic wrap for storage. To prevent a skin or film from forming be sure to place plastic wrap up against the pudding, not just over the top of the bowl.
    Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Honey Butter
recipes.instructions: In electric mixer whip butter about 2 min.  Add honey and whip together until well blended, next add marshmallow creme and blend well.Have all ingredients at room temperature.  I store it in the refrigerator when not being served.This make a lot.  Can easily be halved.

recipes.title: Honey Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: This all-in-one stir-fry with a hint of sweetness from honey is a big time-saver

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb Chicken breast (cut into 1 inch pieces)

ingredients.name: Frozen broccoli stir-fry vegetable blend
ingredients.display_text: 16 oz Frozen broccoli stir-fry vegetable blend

recipes.instructions:
1.   In a large nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken and garlic in 2 teaspoons oil. Add the honey, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is lightly browned and juices run clear. Remove and keep warm.

2.   In the same pan, stir-fry the vegetables in remaining oil for 4-5 minutes or until heated through. Return chicken to the pan; mix well. Combine cornstarch and cold water until smooth; stir into chicken mixture. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened. Serve over rice.

259

recipes.title: Honey-glazed Pineapple Carrots
recipes.instructions: Cut the carrots into 2-inch strips.  In a microwave-safe dish, combine the carrots and water.  Microwave covered on HIGH for 4-6 minutes, until carrots are tender.Add brown sugar, butter, honey, and pineapple.  Mix well and microwave covered for an additional 2 minutes.  Sprinkle with chipped chives or parsley as garnish.

recipes.title: Hot Clam Dip
recipes.instructions: Mix all but clams and cheese with mixer until smooth.  Add drained clams.  Mix with spoon and pour into a Pyrex dish or glass pie plate.  Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.  Bake at 350°F for 20 Minutes.  Serve with carrots or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Indian Vegetable Curry

ingredients.name: cans
ingredients.prep_notes: (15 oz) garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained
ingredients.display_text: 2 cans ((15 oz) garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
Cook onion and carrot in oil for cook 5 minutes or until tender. Add curry
powder, sugar, ginger, and garlic; cook 1 minutes, stirring constantly.
Place mixture in crock pot. Stir in next 7 ingredients. Cook on high for 6
hours or until vegetables are tender. Add spinach and coconut

recipes.title: Italian Beef

ingredients.name: Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients.display_text: 3 packages Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix

recipes.instructions: Cook  roast at 325°F for about 4 hours.  Keep covered while cooking.  Cool and slice thin.  Add to above mixture.  Cook at least one hour before serving.  Serve juice with the meat.  After cooking roast you can take cooled roast back to butcher to slice if you don't have a slicer.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Soup with Tortellini
recipes.instructions:
1. In a 5 quart Dutch oven, brown sausage. Remove sausage and drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of the drippings.
2. Saute onions and garlic in drippings. Stir in beef broth, water, wine, tomatoes, carrots, basil, oregano, tomato sauce, and sausage. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
3. Skim fat from the soup. Stir in zucchini and parsley. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Add tortellini during the last 10 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on top of each serving.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini
recipes.instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Saute' onion until tender.  Mix in tomato, basil, zucchini, sugar, water, lemon juice. Cover; simmer 10 min.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Relish
recipes.instructions: Chop onions and red pepper. Slice jalapenos.  Grate carrots.  Add rest of ingredients and boil for 15 minutes.Seeds of the jalapeno are what make the relish hot or not.  If you want it hot add plenty of seeds, some if you want it medium and none if you want it mild.

recipes.title: Jam Bars
recipes.instructions: Mix oats, flour, soda and sugar.  Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly.  Divide into 2 parts, pack 1/2 firmly in bottom of oiled 7 1/2 x 11" baking pan.  Spread jam evenly on top, then add remaining dough and pack firmly.  Bake in moderate oven 350°F, 40 min.  Cool thoroughly.

recipes.title: Jam Thumbprints
recipes.instructions: Cream butter and sugar till fluffy.  Add egg yolks, vanilla and salt; beat well.  Gradually add flour, mixing well.  Shape into 3/4 inch balls; dip in egg whites, then roll in nuts.  Place 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet.  Press down centers with thumb.  Bake at 350° for 15 -17 minutes.  Cool slightly; remove from pan and cool on rack.  Just before serving, fill centers with preserves.  Makes 36.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken
recipes.instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces.  Sprinkle chicken with ginger, then dredge with flour.  Brown chicken in butter. Mix water, soy sauce, vinegar, and brown sugar.  Pour sauce and then pineapple over chicken.  Turn down heat to low.  Cover and cook for 30 to 45 min.   Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Jello Delight
recipes.instructions:
Mix cool whip and cheese add drained pineapple.  Sprinkle dry jello into it and mix together.  Put into refrigerator to set up.

Kelly's favorite.

recipes.title: Jello Fingers
recipes.instructions:
dissolve jello and gelatin in boiling water.Add cream and pour into 9x9. Put in refrigerator

Description:  "Elsie Thackeray's layered jello fingers"

recipes.title: Karen's Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: instant pudding mix dark chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 small instant pudding mix dark chocolate

recipes.instructions: Soften, mix, freeze enjoy

recipes.title: Katheryn Parson's Butter Rolls
recipes.instructions:
Mix milk, sugar, and butter in bowl, heat until butter starts to melt.  Make sure that milk is the temperature of a baby's bottle then add the yeast, 2 cups flour and salt.  Mix throughly, add eggs and 2 more cups flour.  Keep adding flour until all is added.  Dough will be sticky.

Put in refrigerator over night.  Take 1/2 of dough and divide that into thirds.  Roll each third into a circle brush with melted butter.  Cut into 1/8th roll up.Brush with butter again and let rise for 4 hours.Makes 48 rolls.

Bake 400°F for 10 minutes.  

1/2 batch will fill a big cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Killer Brownies
recipes.instructions: Melt butter, add sugar and cocoa.  Beat in eggs one at a time.  Add flour and vanilla.Pour into 9x13 greased pan; sprinkle on nuts; bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Krieger Pasta Salad
recipes.instructions: Chop, Mix, and enjoy.

recipes.title: Lemon-Spinach Salad
recipes.instructions: Mix oil and lemon juice and zest, salt, pepper, tabasco.  Wisk well.  Add spinach, apples, craisins, oranges, and almonds.  Serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.instructions: Cream butter and 1/2 cup powdered sugar.  Stir in 2 cups flour.  Place in 9 X 13 inch pan.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°F.  Beat eggs, 2 cups sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes.  Lightly mix or fold in 4 tablespoons flour.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°F .  Sprinkle when done with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Lemon Cardamom Drops
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat 1 cup sugar, cream cheese, and butter till fluffy.  Add egg, lemon zest, vanilla and lemon extract, beat till smooth.In a separate bowl combine flour, baking powder and cardamom, add to 1st. mixture til a soft dough is formed.Take the remaining 1/4 c. of sugar and drop ball of dough in, rolling them in the sugar.  Place balls on a greased cookie sheet 2 in. apart.  Flatten the cookies with  bottom of a glass first dipped in sugar.  Bake 5-7 minutes or until bottoms are light brown.  Drizzle with icing.

Icing-3/4 cup powdered sugar, 3 Tablespoons milk, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
recipes.instructions: 1. Pound chicken breast with meat pounder to uniform thickness.  Dredge lightly in flour, shaking off excess.2. In a large saute pan over medium-high hear, melt the butter and oil until it sizzles.  Add the chicken breasts and saute, turning once or twice until cooked through and juices run clear.  Remove chicken and set aside.  3. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minutes until the mixture boils.4. Add lemon juice to the chicken stock and whisk into saute pan.  Reduce heat to a simmer.5. Return chicken to pan to heat through, thickening sauce to desired consistency.  Season to taste with salt and ground white pepper.6. Serve the chicken on a bed of basmati rice, and spoon the sauce over the chicken.  Garnish with chopped parsley and lemon slices.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
recipes.instructions:
Mix 1/2 c. cold water and cornstarch.  Boil hot water and sugar.  Add cornstarch.  Boil hot water and sugar.  Add cornstarch and cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly.  Stir small amount into egg yolks.  Add to mixture and cook 3 minutes longer.  Remove from stove and add lemon rind, juice and butter.  Cool stirring occasionally.  Pour into pie shell.  Top with meringue.

Meringue:  3 egg whites, 6 T. sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice.  Beat egg whites until peaked add sugar gradually, fold in lemon juice.  Brown.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Zucchini Fettuccine

ingredients.name: Fettuccine
ingredients.prep_notes: (that's just 1/2 of a normal box like in the picture)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 lb Fettuccine ((that's just 1/2 of a normal box like in the picture))

recipes.instructions:
Prepare grill. You could also do this on the stove top in a skillet, or a grill pan.

Place chicken in a zip-lock bag with the juice of one lemon, a couple tablespoons of olive oil, and a couple tablespoons of red wine vinegar. Smoosh around and set bag aside while you get your other things ready. (If you've got time to spare, let the chicken marinade for 30 minutes, if you don't, just take what you can get. I did mine for 15 min and it was great.)

slice the zucchini in half length-wise if grilling. Or chop to cook in pan.  Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Press, or finely mince garlic cloves. In a small sauce pan on the stove, place 1/4 C olive oil and add garlic. Turn burner onto low-med heat. It shouldn't be popping and frying, it should just slowly warm, infusing the oil with the garlic and removing that zing fresh garlic has.

Remove chicken from bag and salt and pepper both sides. Place chicken, and zucchini on grill.

While chicky and zuchs are grilling and pasta is boiling, chop herbs and get out cheese. Zest both lemons and juice the one that hasn't been juiced.

Reserve about 1/2 C pasta water. Drain pasta and immediately place in a big bowl. Place chopped zuch and chicken on top. Add lemon zest, lemon juice, cheese, herbs, and garlic-olive oil mixture. 

Now take some tongs and give everything a big toss. If you feel it needs more moisture, add a little of the pasta water, or a little more olive oil. This will make 4 generous servings.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large soup pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onions, carrots, and celery; cook and stir until onion is tender. Stir in garlic, bay leaf, oregano, and basil; cook for 2 minutes.
   2. Stir in lentils, and add water and tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for at least 1 hour. When ready to serve stir in spinach, and cook until it wilts. Stir in vinegar, and season to taste with salt and pepper, and more vinegar if desired.
 Serve with cornbread

recipes.title: London Broil
recipes.instructions: Fork london broil to tenderize.  Mix all other ingredients in a gallon Ziploc bag.  Marinate steak for up to 3 hours.  Broil or BBQ and cut into thin strips to serve.

recipes.title: Lone Star Chicken Fried Steak
recipes.instructions: Trim steak, tenderize, cut into 5 pieces.  Combine flour, salt and pepper.  Dredge all steak pieces in flour mixture until lightly coated.  Combine beaten egg and milk.  Dip steak into egg mixture and dredge again in flour.  Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a heavy skillet.  Place steaks in skillet and fry until golden brown on both sides.  To make gravy, remove steaks to warm oven, retaining 6 tablespoons of drippings (or use bacon drippings).  Add 6 tablespoons flour.  Cook and stir until flour begins to brown.  Add 3 cups hot milk and stir until thickened.  Season with salt and pepper to taste and pour over warm steaks.

recipes.title: Low Fat Pineapple Upside-down Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple rings in juice
ingredients.display_text: 1 can 20 oz pineapple rings in juice (drained)

recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350degrees.  Spray 9x 13 inch pan with nonstick spray.Place 2 tablespoons butter in pan and place in oven to melt; remove pan as soon as it is melted.  Sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of pan.  Evenly distribute pineapple rings over brown - sugar mixture. Set aside.Combine flour and baking soda in a small bowl and st aside.In large bowl, combine 1/4 cup butter and sugar until mixed well.  Add egg whites one at a time.  beating 30 seconds after each addition.  Add vanilla extract and mix well.Add half of flour and soda mixture, then half of buttermilk, mix and repeat.Spoon batter over pineapple - do not stir - then smooth the top.  Bake 40 minutes, or until sharp knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Allow cake to cool 10 minutes, then turn upside down onto serving platter.  Remove any pineapple or sugar that sticks in pan and place it back on cake.

To make it a bit more fattening and a little bit more gooey.  Increase butter to 1/4 cup and brown sugar to 1/2 cup for the gooey bottom.

recipes.title: Low-fat Chicken-tortilla Casserole

ingredients.name: reduced fat cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.display_text: 2 101/2 oz can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: boneless chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 6 boneless chicken breast (cooked and cut up)

recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray a 9 by 13 inch pan with nonstick spray; set aside.  Spray small pan with nonstick spray and cook onion over medium-high heat until softened, adding water or chicken broth if needed.In a large bowl, add onion to soup, milk, sour cream and green chiles.In prepared pan layer 1/3 of the tortillas, then 1/3 of the chicken, 1/3 of the sauce and 1/3 of the cheese.  Repeat two or more times, ending with cheese.Bake 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbling around the edges.

recipes.title: Lyndsay's Curry

ingredients.name: garbanzo beans
ingredients.display_text: 2 can (15 oz) garbanzo beans (rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
Cook the onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes or until tender. Add the curry powder, ginger and garlic; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.

Place the mixture in a slow cooker. Stir in the garbanzo beans, potatoes, green pepper, green beans, black pepper, diced tomatoes and vegetable broth. Cook on high for 6 hours or until the vegetables are tender.

Stir in the spinach and coconut milk and heat through. Serve with lemon wedges.
