recipes.title: Magic Mix

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup butter (at room temperature and cubed)

recipes.instructions:
Combine dry milk, flour and butter into a large bowl. Mix with electric hand mixer until it resembles cornema. Keep mix tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to six months. Yield: 5 cups.

To make alfredo use 1 cup water, 2/3 cup mix and parmeasen to taste. Heat on medium high heat and stir  quickly. add cheese after cooled.

recipes.title: Mama Stamber's Cranberry Relish Recipe
recipes.instructions: Mix the ingredients and freeze.  On Thanksgiving morning, move the mixture to refrigerator to thaw.  Makes 1 1/2 pints.

recipes.title: Mango Quinoa

ingredients.name: cooked quinoa* at room temperature
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups cooked quinoa* at room temperature (or chilled)

recipes.instructions:
*Quinoa can be cooked in water or broth.  I suggest using vegetable or chicken broth for enhanced flavor, but plain water works great too.

Place cooked quinoa in a large bowl.  Add mango, red pepper, green onion, black beans, and cilantro.  In a small bowl combine vinegar, olive oil, and lime juice.  Whisk until smooth and pour on top of salad.  Toss to combine and add salt and pepper to taste.  Chill for at least one hour before serving.

recipes.title: Manicotti
recipes.instructions: Par boil noodles 10 min.  Cool in noodle tray.  Beat eggs and milk with fork, soak bread in this mixture - set aside.  Brown beef and sausage.  Add salt and pepper.  Italian seasoning and parsley.  Mix 1/2 cheese into egg, milk and bread mixture.  Pour into meat mixture, stuff noodles with meat filling.  Place stuffed noodles in greased casserole, side by side.  Pour sauce over the top.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinade
recipes.instructions: Mix marinade.  Take chicken, remove fat, pour sauce over.  Marinate covered with foil for 1 hour.  Bake 1/2 hour, remove foil, baste, cook until done. Or can marinate over night.  Shake every once in a while.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
recipes.instructions: Mix all together put into a loaf pan and bake at 350 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Pepper Salad

ingredients.name: a red onion
ingredients.prep_notes: cut into a 1/2-inch dice (use less if your onion is huge)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 a red onion (cut into a 1/2-inch dice (use less if your onion is huge))

ingredients.name: to 1/2 cup pitted kalmata olives and/or Spanish ol
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 to 1/2 cup pitted kalmata olives and/or Spanish ol

recipes.instructions:
Swish together the red wine vinegar, water, kosher salt and sugar in a small bowl until the salt and sugar are dissolved. Add the red onion and set it aside.
Meanwhile, time to practice your knife skills. Core and seed your bell peppers and chop them into 1/2-inch pieces. Chop the cucumber and feta into similarly-sized chunks. Put your peppers, cucumber, feta and olives in a large bowl.
By now, your onions will have lightly pickled, both sweetening and softening their blow. Drain them and add them to the other vegetables in the large bowl, but reserve the vinegar mixture. Pour a quarter cup of the vinegar mixture over the salad, then drizzle with olive oil. Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper, or to taste. Toss evenly and serve at once, or let the flavors muddle together in the fridge for a few hours.

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Salad

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can black beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans (rinsed and drained)

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can cannellini beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans (drained and rinsed)

recipes.instructions:
1.   In a large bowl, combine beans, bell peppers, frozen corn, and red onion.
   2. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, lime juice, lemon juice, sugar, salt, garlic, cilantro, cumin, and black pepper. Season to taste with hot sauce and chili powder.
   3. Pour olive oil dressing over vegetables; mix well. Chill thoroughly, and serve cold.

recipes.title: Minestrone Hamburger Soup
recipes.instructions: Brown beef and onion in large pan.  Add potatoes, carrots, celery, cabbage and tomatoes.  Bring to boil.  Sprinkle rice into mixture.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Moist Corn Bread
recipes.instructions: Melt butter; add sugar; mix well; add eggs, beating well after each; mix soda with buttermilk; add to egg mixture.  Mix dry ingredients; add to liquid mixture; mix briefly.  Bake in greased 8 x 8 pan at 350°F for 30 - 35 min.

recipes.title: Mom's Sugared Popcorn
recipes.instructions: Cook to 240°F bring down with milk, bring back to 240°F till color you want.  Should be light brown.  Pour over popcornMakes 2 bowls of popcorn.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
recipes.instructions: Remove biscuits from can; cut each into four pieces; combine sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag; place pieces of dough into bag; shake; remove the pieces from bag; stand on edge in a greased bundt pan.  Bring to a boil the margarine, granulated sugar, and brown sugar; pour over the biscuits; bake at 350°F for 20 min. or until done; cool slightly; turn onto a serving plate.

recipes.title: Moose Munch
recipes.instructions: Place popped corn in extra large bowl.  In a large saucepan melt butter over medium heat.  When melted stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.  Stirring constantly until reaching a rolling boil.  Stop stirring and let boil for 5 minutes.  Immediately remove from heat and stir in vanilla and baking soda.  Mixture will foam up.  Pour immediately over popped corn.  Place on large jelly roll pan and allow to coll.  Melt chocolate in a double broiler or in the microwave.  Add nuts at this time them so that they are well coated or else they won't stick to the popped corn.  Pour melted chocolate over popped corn and begin to mix until well coated.  Let cook and place in an airtight container.  This recipe will stay fresh for one week.If the pop corn is still sticky place it in a warm oven until dry.

recipes.title: Muddy Buddies
recipes.instructions: 1. Pour cereal into large bowl; set aside.2.  Melt, chips, peanut butter, margarine in microwave on high 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth, stirring after 1 minute.  Stir in vanilla.3. Pour chocolate mixture over cereals, stirring until all pieces are evenly coated.  Pour cereal mixture into a jumbo size Ziploc bag with powdered sugar.  Seal securely and shake until all pieces are all coated.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto

ingredients.name: pearl barly or Abroio Rice
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup pearl barly or Abroio Rice

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.display_text: 3/4 cup dry white wine ((or however you choose substitute it))

ingredients.name: freshly grated Parmesan or Pecorino
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan or Pecorino

ingredients.name: finely chopped parsley or thyme
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup finely chopped parsley or thyme

recipes.instructions:
Have the stock at a simmer. Heat the oil in a heavy wide pan or soup pot. Add the onion and garlic an cook over medium heat until the onion is translucent, about 4 minutes. Add the barley and cook for 1 minutes, stirring to coat the grains. Raise the heat a little and the wine, and cook, stirring frequently until the wine is nearly absorbed. Add 2 1/2 cups of the stock, cover the pot and simmer until the stock is nearly absorbed.

Now start adding stock 1/2 cup at a time, stirring more or less constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding more. After about 4 minutes the barley should be tender and the dish thick and creamy. You may not need to use the full amount of stock. Stir in the butter, cheese, half of the parsley and lemon juice to taste. Taste for salt and season with pepper. Serve garnished with the remaining parsley.

Heat a small skillet. Add the butter, as the foam begins to subside add the shallot. When it begins to look tender- 2 minutes, add the mushrooms, cook until the release the liquid- about 8 minutes. If they begin to stick and brown too much add a little bit of water, stock, white wine or whatever you choose to scrape the fond up and continue cooking. When mushrooms have finished cooking add the vinegar and turn off the heat. Taste for salt and pepper and garnish with thyme.

recipes.title: Never Fail Flaky Pie Crust
recipes.instructions: Mix flour and salt cut in shortening until fine crumb like texture.  Beat egg, water and vinegar; add flour mixture and roll into 2 pie crusts.

recipes.title: Nichole Blair's Couscous
recipes.instructions: You basically just mix it all together. Refrigerate for 1-2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: No-Knead Rolls
recipes.instructions:
Instructions
Dissolve 1/2 warm water with  1 T. yeast. Put in large bowl;water, sugar, salt and butter. Add 3 cups flour, beat well. Add: yeast mixture, beat well.. Beat well, use a spoon. Leave in bowl. Let rest 10 min. Beat down with spoon. Repeat 5 times. Let rise 30 min. Bake 375°F for 30 min.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
recipes.instructions:
Pour boiling water over oatmeal and margarine.  Mix well.  Let stand 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Combine sugars with eggs; blend well.  Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.  Mix.  Add oatmeal mixture.  Pour into greased 9 x 12 inch pan.  Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes. 

Oatmeal Cake Topping:

1/2 cup margarine1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts1 cup coconut1/2 cup sugar1/4 cup evaporated milk ( can use milk)1/2 teaspoon vanilla

Mix ingredients together and spread on warm cake.  Place under broiler for 5 to 10 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cranberry White Chocolate Chunk Cookies
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.Using an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar together in a medium mixing bowl until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, mixing well.  Combine oats, flour, baking soda and salt in a seperate bowl.  Add to butter mixture in several additions, mixing well after each addition.  Stir in sweetened dried cranberries and white chcocolate chips.Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool on wire rack.  Makes approzimately 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
Combine flour, oats, brown sugar, soda and salt.  Whisk in eggs, oil, and buttermilk and mix just until dry ingredients are well moistened; thin with water if needed.  Spread batter on hot griddle, turning one.Yield:  16 4 inch pancakes.

*Buttermilk substitute:  Put 2 tablespoons cider vinegar or lemon juice in 2 cup measure; add milk to equal 2 cups.  Stir and let stand a few minutes to thicken.* To use dry milk:  Mix 1/2 cup dry milk with dry ingredients.  Put 2 tablespoons vinegar or lemon juice in cup; add water to equal scant 2 cups buttermilk.Note:  Pancakes will be thinner when using either of these substitutions.

These pancakes are great with cider syrup and fried apples.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.instructions: Reserve 1/2 cup flour.  Put cut up orange slices into reserved flour.  Sift remaining flour, baking powder and soda and salt together.  Cream shortening and sugar, beat in egg and vanilla.  Stir in sifted dry ingredients.  Add oatmeal, coconut, and floured orange pieces.  Mix well.  Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet or roll into ball and press out.  Bake 350° for 8 - 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Sugar Ring
recipes.instructions: Separate biscuits; combine butter and orange juice; mix remaining ingredients in a separate bowl; dip biscuits in butter, then in sugar mixture; stand upright in well greased bundt pan; bake at 450°F for 12-15 min.; turn out onto plate. Don't over bake.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
recipes.instructions:
Wash and dry chicken.  Combine flour and seasonings in paper bay.  Shake 2 or 3 pieces chicken at a time in flour mixture.  In shallow pan in oven melt butter; remove pan from oven.  Arrange chicken in pan in single layer, with skin side down.  Bake, uncovered, 30 minute; turn chicken pieces with tongs; bake 15 minutes or until brown and fork tender.

CREAM GRAVY:Pour drippings from baking pan into measuring cup.  Measure 1/2 cup fat into skillet; add 6 tablespoons flour (left over from coating chicken plus more flour as needed).  Stir over low heat, loosening brown bits from baking pan, till smooth.  Stir in 1 cup chicken broth and 1 1/2 cups half and half cream.  Cook, stirring in a little water.  Serve with chicken.

recipes.title: Oven Potatoes
recipes.instructions: Peel, rinse and cut potatoes lengthwise in 8th.  Melt butter in square cake pan.  Do not brown.  Heat oven to 425°.  Add potatoes, turn to coat with butter, bake for 30 minutes until partly browned on underside.  Turn the potatoes and continue baking until they are quite soft on the inside and crisp on the outside.  Sprinkle with salt and serve at once.

recipes.title: Pasta con Broccoli
recipes.instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water in medium saucepan until 1/2 done (about 4 minutes).  Drain and return to pan.  Add cream, butter, garlic, tomato sauce and broccoli and bring to boil over medium heat about 4-5 minutes.  When noodles are done, stir in mushrooms to heat.  Remove and sprinkle with cheese.  Salt and pepper.  Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: red and green bell peppers
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup red and green bell peppers (diced)

recipes.instructions: Cook rotini noodles, drain, rinse, cool.   Blanch carrots and broccoli, cool, add to rotini, then add rest of ingredients.  Add just enough dressing to suit your own personal taste.

recipes.title: Peach Cake
recipes.instructions: Cream margarine and brown sugar; stir in egg; add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir in peaches.  Bake in 9 x 13 greased pan at 350°F for 30 -35 min. while still hot, add topping of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
recipes.instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish while mixing batter.  When margarine is melted, pour batter over it and then spoon on the peaches.  Bake at 350°F until brown or 1 hour.  I use 1 qt. undrained peaches with 1 cup frozen blueberries or raspberries.

recipes.title: Peach French Toast
recipes.instructions: Over medium-low heat, stir brown sugar and butter until butter melts.  Add water and cook until sauce is thick and foamy about 5 minutes.  Pour into 9x13x2 inch baking dish.  Let cool 10 minutes.Place peaches on top of sauce.  Cover with bread, trimming to fit in one layer.  Whisk together eggs, milk and vanilla.  Pour over bread.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bake at 350°F, uncovered, 40 minutes or until set and golden. Cover with foil if browning too quickly.  Serve with warmed reserved peach syrup, if desired.  This is rich and yummy.

recipes.title: Peach Torte
recipes.instructions:
Arrange a rack in the lower third of the oven. preheat the oven in 350. 

In mixer cream 3/4 cup sugar and butter. add the flour, baking powder, eggs and salt and beat the mixture well.  Place in 9 or 10 inch ungreased springform pan. cover the top with LOTS of  peaches. Mix the cinnamon with the remaining 1-2 tabls sugar and sprinkle over the top.

Bake for 45-50 minutes until the center tests done. remoe and cool. 

(This can be frozen for several months well wrapped, to serve return to room tempature and reheat at 300 until warm.) 

This works well with any stone fruit, plum etc)

recipes.title: Peach Upside Down Cake

ingredients.name: peaches cut into 1 in. wedges
ingredients.display_text: 4 large peaches cut into 1 in. wedges

recipes.instructions: Topping-91/2 inch or 10 in. non-stick ovenproof skillet.Mix sugar with 3T. water - boil swirling pan till starts to turn light brown.  Remove from heat.stir in butter, lemon juice and nectar.  Cool slightly.  Arrange peach slices, (overlapping peaches)Cake - Sift flour, baking powder, soda and spices.  Mix egg, sugar, butter and extracts, beat 3 minutes until pale and smooth.Mix egg and flour alternating with buttermilk.  Spread over peaches.Bake 350 25-30 minutes.  Let sit 5 minutes - flip over.

recipes.title: Peek a Berry Boos
recipes.instructions: Sift first 4 ingredient.Cream sugars and butters.Add next 3  ingredients.  Beat well, blend in dry ingredients, add 2 cups quick oatmeal.  Mix thoroughly. Spread half into greased cookie sheet, spread layer of jam, spread second half of cookie dough.  Bake 400°F 15-20 min.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crunch Bark

ingredients.name: red and white hard peppermint candies
ingredients.display_text: 30 red and white hard peppermint candies

recipes.instructions: Turn large baking sheet bottom side up.  Cover securely with foil.  Mark 12 x 9 inch rectangle on foil.  Stir white chcoclate in metal bowl set over saucepan of barely simmering water (do not allow bottom of bowl to touch water) until chocolate is melted and smooth and candy thermometer registers 110.  Remove from over water.  Pour 2/3 cup melted white chocolate onto rectangle on foil.  Using icing spatula, spread chocolate to fill rectangle.  Sprinkle with 1/4 cup crushed peppermints.  Chill until set, about 15 minutes.Stir bittersweet chcoclate, cream and peppermint extract in heavy medium saucepan over medium low heat until just melted and smooth.  Cool to barely lukewarm, about 5 minutes.  Pour bittersweet chocolate misture in long lines over white chocolate rectangle.  Using icing spatula spread bittersweet chocolate in even layer.  Refrigerate until very cold and firm, about 25 minutes.Rewarm remaining white chocolate in bowl set over barely simmering water to 110F. Working quickly, pour white chocolate over firm bittersweet chocolate layer; spread to cover.  Immediately sprinkle with remaining crushed peppermints.  Chill just until firm, about 20 minutes.Lift foil with bark onto work surface; trim edges.  Cut bark crosswise into 2- inch - wide strips.  Using metal spatula, slide bark off foil and onto work surface.  cut each strip crosswise into 3 sections and each section diagonally into 2 triangles.

recipes.title: Pesto

ingredients.name: pine nuts or walnuts
ingredients.display_text: 3 tbsp pine nuts or walnuts (toasted and chopped)

recipes.instructions: To make the pesto:In a blender or small food processor blend together all ingredients with salt and pepper to taste until smooth. Pesto keeps, covered and chilled, up to 1 week. Makes about 2/3 cup.

recipes.title: Pico de Gallo
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in covered bowl in refrigerator for 5 - 6 hours.  Serve on fajitas, or tacos.

recipes.title: Pizza Bites

ingredients.name: roll refrigerated pizza dough*
ingredients.display_text: 1 roll refrigerated pizza dough* ((or make your own))

ingredients.name: olive oil or melted butter
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp olive oil or melted butter

recipes.instructions:
You can use regular pizza dough, or thin crust.  
Combine ingredients in a jar (preferably one with a sprinkle top) and shake.  Sprinkle on top of breadsticks or combine 1 1/2 Tbsp. seasoning with 1/2 c. of softened real butter and spread on a loaf of French bread (cut in 1/2 lengthwise). Wrap in foil and bake at 375 until butter's melted. If you want, you could also pop it open-faced under the broiler for a few minutes so it gets brownish and crispy.

Preheat oven to heat specified on pizza dough package.  Usually it's 400 degrees.  If you make your own dough, 400 is usually a good heat as well.

Unroll your pizza dough onto a lightly floured surface.  Pat or roll the dough so it's about 12" by 8".  You're going to want to cut it into 24 squares, so just eyeball it if you need to.  Use a pizza cutter to slice the dough into 24 squares (bet ya didn't see that one comin' did ya?)  

Place cheese and desired toppings on each square.  (Note that you're not putting the marinara sauce on the dough- it's for dipping after)  You guys are smart, right?  Just eyeball how much.  You just need to be able to enclose the toppings in the dough so keep that in mind. 

When all of your dough squares have cheese and toppings on them, carefully lift up each square and wrap the dough around the toppings.  Pinch to make sure each ball is sealed shut and then place them seam side down in a lightly sprayed pie pan (or similar sized dish). 

Brush the tops of the dough balls with olive oil or melted butter (I've used both and there's not much difference in result) and then sprinkle with the garlic and Italian seasoning and top with Parmesan cheese.  (In lieu of the Parmesan, garlic, and Italian seasoning you could  substitute this garlic bread seasoning.)

Cook them in the oven for about 15-20 minutes or until golden brown on top.  Keep an eye  on them! Doughs vary, so I'd check them after even 10 minutes.

Serve warm with warmed marinara sauce on the side for dipping.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough - Sandra's

ingredients.name: to 5 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep_notes: divided, plus additional for dusting (I often go half whole whe
ingredients.display_text: 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour (divided, plus additional for dusting (I often go half whole whe)

recipes.instructions:
Whisk together yeast, 2 tablespoons flour, and 1/2 cup warm water in a measuring cup and let stand until mixture develops a creamy foam, about 10 minutes. (If mixture doesn’t foam, discard and start over with new yeast.)
Stir together salt and 3 cups flour in a large bowl. Add yeast mixture and remaining 1 1/2 cups warm water and stir until smooth, then stir in 1 cup more flour. If dough sticks to your fingers, stir in just enough flour (up to 3/4 cup), a little at a time, to make dough just come away from side of bowl. (This dough may be wetter than other pizza doughs you have made.)
Knead dough on a lightly floured surface with floured hands, lightly reflouring work surface and your hands when dough becomes too sticky, until dough is smooth, soft, and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Divide dough in half and form into 2 balls, then generously dust balls all over with flour and put each in a medium bowl. Cover bowls with plastic wrap and let dough rise in a draft-free place at warm room temperature until doubled, 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.instructions: Empty tomato paste into a bowl and add water a few tablespoons at a time, stirring constantly until combined. Add remaining ingredients, stir to combine, and allow to stand until ready to use. Covers two average-sized pizza; freezes extremely well.

recipes.title: Play Dough
recipes.instructions: heat and let it cool for a minute. Then knead it together with hands.  Store in ziplock or tupperware.

recipes.title: Plum Torte
recipes.instructions:
Arrange a rack in the lower third of the oven.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.

In an electric mixer, cream the 3/4 cup of sugar and butter.  Add the flour, baking powder, eggs and salt and beat to mix well.  Place in a 9 or 10 inch ungreased springform pan.  Cover the top with the plums.  Mix the cinnamon with the remaining 1 or 2 tablespoons of sugar and spinkle over the top.

Bake for 40 to 50 minutes until the center tests done with a toothpick.  Remove and cool to room temperature or serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

Note.  The torte may be regrigerated or frozen for several months, well wrapped.  To serve return to room temperature and reheat at 300 degrees until warm.

This works well with any stone fruit.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.instructions: Mix dry ingredients.  Mix egg, milk and oil.  Combine, stir in poppy seed and lemon peel.  Grease 12 muffin cups.  Bake 400°F, 20 min or till golden.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meatballs
recipes.instructions: Combine meat, rice, egg, parsley, onion, salt, pepper, and 1/4 cup condensed tomato soup.  Mix thoroughly; shape in about 20 small balls and place in skillet.  Mix remaining soup, water, and Worcestershire sauce; pour over meatballs, add sliced carrots.  Bring to boil; reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 - 40 minutes, stirring every once in a while.

recipes.title: Pork Sausage-rice Casserole

ingredients.name: dried chicken noodle soup
ingredients.display_text: 1 package dried chicken noodle soup (uses 4 cups of)

recipes.instructions: Cook onion and celery in butter until transparent stirring occasionally.  Add crumbled pork sausage and cook until done.  Drain off excess fat.  Make chicken noodle soup according to directions on package.  Add meat  mixture and dry rice.  Put in 3 1/2 qt. casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Bake uncovered.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredient except pork.  In a large zip lock bag place pork and marinade and let set in refrigerator for 30-60 minutes.  Broil or grill 3 inches from heat for 10-12 minutes or until meat reaches temperature of 160°F.  Slice and enjoy.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients together and tip with crushed potato chips.  Bake one hour at 375°F.

recipes.title: Potato Soup 1
recipes.instructions:
In pot, cook peas, carrots, celery, and potatoes in water to cover, boil 15 minutes.

In large pot put 2 quarts water, bouillon, and onion bring to boil and turn down.

Melt margarine, add flour and stir til paste.  Put 1/2 cup of the onion water into margarine and stir.  Add rest of onion water.  Soften cheese wiz and put into onion stock, add veggies, salt and pepper.  Eat.

recipes.title: Potato Soup 2

ingredients.name: whole Small Russet Potatoes
ingredients.display_text: 6 whole Small Russet Potatoes (Peeled And Diced)

ingredients.name: Grated Cheese Of Your Choice
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup Grated Cheese Of Your Choice

ingredients.name: Low Sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Broth
ingredients.display_text: 8 cups Low Sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Broth

recipes.instructions:
Add bacon pieces to a soup pot over medium heat and cook bacon until crisp and fat is rendered. Remove the bacon from the pot and set it aside. Pour off most of the grease, but do not clean the pot.
Return the hot to medium-high heat and add the onions, carrots, and celery. Stir and cook for 2 minutes or so, then add the diced potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes, seasoning with salt, pepper, and Cajun spice.
Pour in the broth and bring it to a gentle boil. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are starting to get tender. Whisk together the flour and the milk, then pour into the soup and allow the soup to cook for another 5 minutes.
Remove half to 2/3 the soup and blend in a blender/food process until completely smooth. Pour it back into the soup pot and stir to combine. Let it heat back up as you taste for seasonings, adding more of what it needs. Stir in cream, then stir in parsley, reserving a little for garnish.
Serve in bowls garnished with parsley, grated cheese and crisp bacon pieces.

recipes.title: Pretzels
recipes.instructions:
In a large bowl. mix yeast and sugar in warm water; let sit 5 minutes

Stir in salt and 2-3 C. flour for soft batter

Keeping your hands dusted with flour, knead inenough additional flour to make a dough stiff enough to roll out.

Still keeping your hands dusted, take a lump of dough about the size of a peach, and roll it between your hands to make an 8"or 12' rope about as thick as your finger.

Twist the rope into a pretzel and place it on a greased cookie sheet, brush it with a beaten egg, and sprinkle coarse salt on top.  Repeat until all dough is used up.

Bake at 425°F for 12-15 min. or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.instructions: Place pork butt in crockpot or large kettle on stove.  Cook until very tender and breaks apart easily with fork.  Season with salt and pepper.  Remove from crockpot when done and remove all fat.  Return shredded pork back to crockpot and cover with your favorite barbecue sauce and simmer for one hour.  Serve on sourdough buns or regular hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins

ingredients.name: chocolate chips - large milk chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup chocolate chips - large milk chocolate

recipes.instructions: Mix dry ingredients together.  Break eggs in another bowl.  Add pumpkin and butter.  Whisk till blended.  Stir in choc chips.  Bake 350. 20-25 min.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.instructions: Mix together the flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt.  Make a well and add liquid ingredients.  Spoon into muffin tins.  Bake at 350°F for 13-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry Cheesecake
recipes.instructions: Make cake mix according to the directions on the package.  Divide the batter evenly into two greased and floured 9 1/2 x 13" baking pans.  While the cakes are baking, make one package of raspberry danish dessert using the liquid from the thawed raspberries for part of the water.  Let the pudding cool, then fold in the drained raspberries.  Blend together the cream cheese and powdered sugar.  Fold in the cool whip and blend very well.  Spread this over the cooled cakes.  Then spread the cooled danish dessert over the top and chill.  Cut and serve.  (This can be made a day ahead of when it will be used.)

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description:
Prep Time: 15 Minutes
Cook Time: 45 Minutes
	
Ready In: 1 Hour
Servings: 4
"This terrific dish is loaded with succulent Mediterranean vegetables."
recipes.instructions:
1.    Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat bottom and sides of a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

2.    Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Saute garlic until lightly browned. Mix in parsley and eggplant. Saute until eggplant is soft, about 10 minutes. Season with salt to taste.

3.    Spread eggplant mixture evenly across bottom of prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle with a few tablespoons of Parmesan cheese. Spread zucchini in an even layer over top. Lightly salt and sprinkle with a little more cheese. Continue layering in this fashion, with onion, mushrooms, bell pepper, and tomatoes, covering each layer with a sprinkling of salt and cheese.

4.    Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.instructions:
Roast the nuts or seeds in a dry skillet over medium-high heat until golden brown. Sprinkle on the sugar and couple of pinches of salt. Stir until the sugar melts and coats the nuts. Transfer to a plate and let cool.

Cook pasta according to package directions or if making the spinach salad version, wash and dry spinach leaves.

Heat 2 T. olive oil in large skillet and saute the onion for a minute or two with a couple of pinches of salt. Stir in the garlic, and the cabbage, and a few more pinches of salt. Stir and cook for just a minute or so, or until the cabbage softens up JUST A TOUCH. Then stir in rosemary, raisins, and 1 T. vinegar. Fold in the feta cheese and nuts. Pour cabbage mixture over pasta or spinach leaves that has been tossed with 2 T. of the balsamic vinegar and 2 T. of olive oil. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Chicken Keleguin
recipes.instructions:
1. Prehead the oven to 400 degrees F. Pierce softest eye of coconut with a metal skewer or screwdriver and drain liquid into a bowl to sample (see note, above). Bake coconut in oven 15 minutes. With a hammer or back of a heavy cleaver break shell and with point of a strong knife remove flesh, levering it out carefully. Remove brown membrane with a sharp paring knife or vegetable peeler. Grate coconut into bowl.
2. Reduce the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Place whole chicken into a roasting pan. Roast in the oven for 1 hour, or until the leg moves easily within its socket. Remove from the oven, and allow the chicken to cool slightly.
3. Remove the skin from the chicken and discard. Tear the meat from the bones, and chop into small pieces. Discard bones, and place the chicken in a large bowl. Stir in green onions and grated coconut. Sprinkle liberally with lemon juice. Season with salt and red pepper flakes. Taste and adjust amounts of lemon juice, salt and red pepper so that one does not overwhelm the others.

Serve with Reid's Famous Coconut Rice

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Coconut Rice
recipes.instructions: 1.  In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, water, sugar, and salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Stir in rice. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 18 to 20 minutes, until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Coleslaw
recipes.instructions:
1. Be sure cabbage and carrots are chopped up into very fine pieces (about the size of rice).

2. Combine the mayonaise, sugar, milk, buttermilk, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl and beat until smooth.

3. Add the cabbage, carrots, and onion, and mix well.

4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Lemon Spinach Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Zest the lemon into a mixing bowl.
2. Slice the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.
3. Add olive oil to bowl and whisk ingredients.
4. Add 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar to bowl. Add remaining 1/2 tablespoon to taste. Whisk.
5. Pour over spinach in a salad bowl. Add craisins, candied almonds, and apple slices.
6. Mix salad up and serve.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Orange Chicken
recipes.description: This chicken is tangy and flavorful.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display_text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts (chopped into bite sized pieces)

ingredients.name: crushed hot red chili pepper
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 tsp crushed hot red chili pepper

ingredients.name: rice wine or white grape juice
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp rice wine or white grape juice

recipes.instructions:
1. Place chicken pieces in large bowl.
2. Stir in egg, salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon oil and mix well.
3. Stir cornstarch and flour together.
4. Add chicken pieces, stirring to coat.
5. Heat oil for deep-frying in wok or deep-fryer to 375 degrees.
6. Add chicken, small batches at a time, and fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden crisp.
7. (Do not overcook chicken).
8. Remove chicken from oil with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels; set aside.
9. Clean wok and heat 15 seconds over high heat.
10. Add 1 tablespoon oil.
11. Add ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant; about 10 seconds.
12. Add and stir-fry crushed chiles and green onions.
13. Add rice wine and stir 3 seconds.
14. Add Orange Sauce and bring to boil.
15. Add cooked chicken, stirring until well mixed.
16. Stir water into remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch until smooth and add to chicken.
17. Heat until sauce is thickned.
18. Stir in sesame oil and orange zest if desired.
19. Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Toffee Delight
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
2. Arrange crackers in a single layer on the bottom of a 10x15 inch pan that has sides.
3. Boil the butter and the brown sugar together for 3 minutes. Pour evenly over the crackers. Be careful it's extremely hot and sticky.
4. Bake at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 7 minutes.
5. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle chocolate chips over hot mixture. Wait a few minutes for them to melt, then spread evenly with the back of a spoon. While still hot spread finely chopped walnuts over the top. Break or cut into desired size pieces.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Treats
recipes.instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low hear.  Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.  Cook over low heat 3 minutes longer, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.  Add Rice Krispies cereal.  Stir until well coated.  Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 X 9 inch pan.  Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.prep_notes: enough to just cover the rice
ingredients.display_text: milk (enough to just cover the rice)

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.prep_notes: 1 egg per cup of milk; adjust to amount of rice
ingredients.display_text: 2-4 eggs (1 egg per cup of milk; adjust to amount of rice)

recipes.instructions:
Place leftover rice in a pan. Add enough milk to just cover the rice and simmer.

Add salt and sugar to taste. Beat 2 to 4 eggs, using 1 egg per cup of milk. Add the beaten eggs to the rice and stir until it barely thickens.

Pour into a container to stop the cooking action and prevent curdling.

recipes.title: Rich and Charlie's Italian Salad
recipes.instructions:
Mix olive oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic powder and dried mustard together with a whip.  Set aside

Wash lettuce and tear into bite-size pieces into a salad bowl.  Add remaining ingredients to lettuce.  Pour dressing mixture that has been set aside on and toss.  Serve immediately.

This makes way too much dressing.  You could have it or 1/4 it and still have plenty.

recipes.title: Roast
recipes.instructions:
place roast in crock pot, salt and pepper the roast

peel carrots and potatoes

cut up carrots, potatoes, and onions

place cut up vegetables in crock pot

mix the cream of mushroom soup and the onion soup mix and half a cup of water

pour mixture over the roast and vegetable mix

put on lid

cook on high for 4-6 hours

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetables
recipes.instructions: Peel sweet potatoes, squash, and carrots, and garlic.  (Don't chop up garlic but keep them whole cloves, they become so sweet when they are roasted)  Chop up all vegetables into equal size pieces.  Place foil on a cookie sheet and spray it with cooking spray.  Place all vegetables on the cookie sheet so that none of the vegetables overlap.  Sprinkle salt on vegetables.  I'll make two if I'm having company.  Bake in 350°F oven for 20 minutes.  Turn vegetables over and bake for another 20 minutes.  If desired, broil the vegetables for the last 3-5 minutes to make more roasted.

recipes.title: Root Beer Popcorn
recipes.instructions: Boil 1 1/2 minutes.  Take off heat add 1 teaspoon root beer extract.  Pour over 4-5 qt. popcorn.

recipes.title: Royal Frosting
recipes.instructions: Combine egg whites, powdered sugar, vanilla, and cream of tartar.  Beat with electric mixer 7 to 10 minutes or till frosting is very stiff.  Keep frosting covered with damp cloth at all times to prevent crust from forming.  Makes 3 cups

recipes.title: Salty Oats

ingredients.name: package top quality bittersweet chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 10 oz package top quality bittersweet chocolate

recipes.instructions: In large bowl beat butter a few minutes on medium-high speed until light and fluffy.  Scrape down sides of bowl and add sugars, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamo, beating until mixture is well blended.  Reduce speed to medium and add eggs and vanilla extract, mixing until well incorporated.  Reduce speed to low and add flour and oats, scraping down sides of bowl as necessary and mixing  just until they are incorporated.  Add chocolate chips, if using.Cover bowl with plastic wrap and chill dough for at least an hour before baking.Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Line large baking sheet with parchment paper.Form dough into golf ball size balls and place about 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.  Sprinkle sea salt on top of each ball of dough. Transfer cookies, still on parchment paper, to a wire rack to cool completely.We took a bar or dark chocolate and chopped it up to put into the cookies.  They were wonderful.

recipes.title: Savory Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: "Oh so creamy under that crumb topping! Chicken blessed with Swiss cheese and a subtle cream sauce."

ingredients.name: Cream of Chicken Soup
ingredients.display_text: 1 can (10.5 oz) Cream of Chicken Soup

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. Place chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Season with ground black pepper to taste. Top each breast with a slice of cheese.
3. Mix together the soup and milk and pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and drizzle with melted butter/margarine. Bake covered in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Savory Croissant Rolls
recipes.instructions: Blend cream cheese and butter.  Then add next six ingredients.  Blend Well.  Separate croissant rolls.  Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture on large end of triangle.  Roll up and place on cookie sheet.  Brush tops with melted butter.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake 350°F for 20 min or until brown.  Be careful not to burn.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
recipes.instructions: Layer in clear bowl, water chestnuts, a layer of celery, and peas (do not cook).  Stir mayonnaise and sour cream and frost top of salad like a cake.  Be sure to seal edges.  Sprinkle with sugar and sprinkle with cheese and bacon.  Let set overnight or at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Paesano
recipes.instructions: Clean and devein shrimp and soak in half and half for 10 minutes.  Drain and dredge in flour.  Saute in oil over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until pink.  Remove shrimp and place on baking pan in preheated oven.  Broil five minutes or until golden brown. Do not turn or move shrimp. (important for crisp shrimp) Drain, pour on sauce and serve.To make sauce, mix egg yolk and lemon juice in heavy sauce pan.  Add half of the butter and stir over low heat until melted.  Add garlic and remaining butter.  Stir briskly until butter melts and sauce thickens.  Add chives and parsley.Serve with buttered linquine noodles.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.instructions: Brown beef, celery and onion.  Drain.  Stir in rest and simmer covered for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Smitten Kitchen Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie

ingredients.name: plus 2 tablespoons

recipes.instructions: 1. Sift flours, baking soda, baking powder and salt into a bowl. Set aside.2. Press plastic wrap against dough and refrigerate for 24 to 36 hours. [Dough may be used in batches, and can be refrigerated for up to 72 hours.]3. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a nonstick baking mat. Set aside.4. Scoop 6 3 1/2-ounce mounds of dough (the size of generous golf balls) onto baking sheet, making sure to turn horizontally any chocolate pieces that are poking up; it will make for a more attractive cookie. Sprinkle lightly with sea salt and bake until golden brown but still soft, 18 to 20 minutes. Transfer sheet to a wire rack for 10 minutes, then slip cookies onto another rack to cool a bit more. Repeat with remaining dough, or reserve dough, refrigerated, for baking remaining batches the next day. Eat warm, with a big napkin.* I found Valrhona's fèves or oval-shaped chocolate pieces, at Whole Foods in half pounds. Baking discs can be found from a number of brands, from Jacques Torres to E. Guittard (Fresh Direct used to sell these by the quarter pound, but now just in one pound boxes, but still at a very reasonable price) to Ghiradelli. Can't find them? recipes.title: Snapper
recipes.instructions:
Make a thick bed of spinach leaves in bottom of a 9 x 13

Brush with melted butter, salt and pepper.

Lay fillet on top, salt and pepper a little bit.

Spread fresh pico-de-gillo.  Then squeeze a little bit of fresh lime juice on top.

Bake 400°F. for 20 minutes remove foil last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.  In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.  Beat in eggs and vanilla.  Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt.  Shape dough into balls.  Combine sugar and cinnamon; roll ball of dough in sugar mixture.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten slightly.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are set.

recipes.title: Sno Cone Syrup

ingredients.name: extract of choice
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp extract of choice (peppermint, lemon, or vanilla)

recipes.instructions:
Combine one cup of water with two cups granulated sugar in a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat.

Continue heating the mixture until all of the sugar has dissolved, and you are left with a slightly syrupy consistency.

Add one tablespoon of your extract of choice. Peppermint, lemon, and vanilla all work well, but choose the one you like best for your homemade snow cone syrup.

Add a few drops of food coloring, if desired, to the syrup. Stir well to combine all ingredients, and allow the snow cone syrup to cool in the refrigerator for a few hours before drizzling over shaved ice.

Store any leftover snow cone syrup in the refrigerator until ready to use again, and discard after one week if any portion is unused. Be sure to label the container if you make more than one batch of the same color.

recipes.instructions:

recipes.title: Spaghetti with Broccoli Cream Pesto

ingredients.name: Freshly
ingredients.prep_notes: ground black pepper or pinches of red pepper flak
ingredients.display_text: Freshly (ground black pepper or pinches of red pepper flak)

recipes.instructions:
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil for your pasta.

Remove broccoli florets from stems and chop into medium florets. Peel stems with a vegetable peeler (I do this so that they cook quickly, plus, I prefer their taste without the tough stem skin.) and slice them into 1/2-inch segments.

Use your pot of future pasta water to steam (by suspending a mesh strainer over your pasta pot and covering it with a lid for 5 to 6 minutes)) or par-boil (for 3 to 5 minutes) your broccoli florets and stems until just tender, then drain if needed and set them aside.

Add pasta to water and cook until al dente, or about one minute less than fully cooked. Before draining pasta, reserve a cup of pasta cooking water and set it aside. Drain pasta.

Wipe out pot so that you can use it again. In the bottom of pot, melt butter and olive oil together over medium heat. Add onion and reduce to medium-low, sauteing it until tender, about 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook for another two minutes. Add steamed broccoli, salt and red or black pepper and turn the heat back up to medium-high, cooking it with the onion and garlic for a few additional minutes. Pour cream over mixture and let cook for 30 seconds.

Transfer broccoli mixture and all of its creamy bits at the bottom of the pan to a blender or food processor and blend in short bursts until it’s finely chopped and a little sauce. Don’t worry if it looks dry; that reserved pasta water will give it the sauciness it needs in a minute. (Theoretically, one could also use an immersion blender here inside their pot to make the broccoli sauce, but it might be a bit messy with all of the chunks and small bits.)

Add the broccoli sauce back to the pot with the drained spaghetti and a splash or two of the reserved pasta water. Cook over medium-high for 1 to 2 minutes, tossing the mixture so that it evenly coats. Add more pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce. Adjust seasonings to taste, adding more salt or pepper, and scoop into a serving bowl. Shower spaghetti with grated parmesan and dig in.

Do ahead: I make a large batch of the sauce and keep it in the fridge for several days, boiling a little pasta each day for lunch when I make it for Jacob.

recipes.instructions:
Combine the beef and soy sauce in a medium bowl; cover with plastic wrap and regrigerate at least 10 minutes or up to 1 hour, stirring once.  Meanwhile, whisk the apple juice, chicken broth, oyster sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a measuring cup.  Combine the garlic, ginger, and 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil in a small bowl.

Drain the beef and discard the liquid.  Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil in a nonstick 12 inch skillet over high heat until smoking.  Add half of the beef to the skillet and break up the clumps; cook with stirring, 1 minute, then stir and cook until the beef is browned about the edges, about 30 seconds.  Transfer the beef to a medium bowl.  Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil to the skillet, heat until just smoking, and repeat with the remaining beef.

Add 1 Tablespoon of the oil to the now - empty skillet; heat until just smoking.  Add the broccoli and cook 30 seconds; add  the water, cover the pan, and lower the heat to medium.  Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp, about 2 minutes; transfer to a peper towel-lined plate.

Add the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons oil to the skillet; increase the heat to high and heat until just smoking.  Add the bell pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until spotty brown, about 1 1/2 minutes.

Clear the center of the skillet; add the garlic and ginger mixture to the clearing and cook, mashing the mixture with a spoon, until fragrant, 15 to 20 seconds, then stir the mixture into the peppers.  Return the beef and broccoli to the skillet and toss to combine.  Whisk the sauce to recombine, then add to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is thickened and evenly distributed, about 30 seconds.  Transfer to a serving platter.  Serve with rice.

recipes.instructions:
Preheat an oven to 190º C (375º F).  Place sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for an hour or until soft.
    Remove sweet potatoes from oven and peel them (you may want to let them cool a little, they are hot – I just peeled them with my hands), then mash with a fork.
    In a large stockpot, heat oil on medium-high heat.  When hot, add in onions, garlic, lemongrass, and ginger, and let cook until fragrant and translucent.
    Add to the soup bell peppers, mushrooms, and curry paste and let cook about 5 more minutes, stirring every couple minutes to make sure everything is flavored well with the curry paste.
    Pour in the water, bring back to a simmer, then remove from heat.  Remove the lemongrass from the soup (but keep because we’ll be adding it back in later) and use the immersion blender to purée the soup in the pot.
    Add in the mashed sweet potato and coconut milk, and use the immersion blender to purée again the soup so that everything is smooth.
    Return the lemongrass to the soup and place the soup back on the stove – bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low and let cook at a low simmer for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors develop.

ingredients.name: pounds sweet potato

recipes.instructions:

Carefully flip each piece: the undersides should be blistery, dark and a bit puffy and should release from the pan with no effort. If they’re not, let it cook longer. Sprinkle them with additional salt and freshly ground black pepper and return the pan to the oven for another 10 minutes or so, until the undersides match the tops.

Meanwhile, prepare your salad. Chop your pecans well, mince your shallot, chop your celery and parsley, mince cranberries if using them. Crumble your goat cheese. If you, like me, got too soft of a goat cheese for mixing, set it aside and sprinkle it on top. If it’s firmer, stir it into the mixture. In a small dish, whisk together 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar and 1/2 teaspoon dijon. Pour half over salad.

When the sweet potatoes are done, set a couple coins aside just in case the baby isn’t into the toppings. Lay the rest on a serving platter. Scoop a spoonful of the salsa over each round. Pour remaining salad dressing over top, to taste. Eat immediately.

Remove pizza from oven. Sprinkle on shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and cilantro leaves.

recipes.title: Tres Leches Cake
recipes.description: "This cake is made with three layers: Cake, filling, and topping. There are 4 types of milk in the filling and topping (whole milk, condensed milk, evaporated milk, and heavy cream). This is an excellent cake for milk lovers!" — Stephanie
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour one 9x13 inch baking pan.
2. Sift flour and baking powder together and set aside.
3. Cream butter or margarine and the 1 cup sugar together until fluffy. Add eggs and the 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract; beat well.
4. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture 2 tablespoons at a time; mix until well blended. Pour batter into prepared pan.
5. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 30 minutes. Pierce cake several times with a fork.
6. Combine the whole milk, condensed milk, and evaporated milk together. Pour over the top of the cooled cake.
7. Whip whipping cream, the remaining 1 cup of the sugar, and the remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla together until thick. Spread over the top of cake. Be sure and keep cake refrigerated, enjoy!

recipes.title: Tuna Ring with Cheese Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Heat oven to 375°F.  Beat egg slightly; set aside 2 tablespoons of the egg.  Stir tuna, onion, cheese, parsley, celery salt and pepper into remaining egg.  Stir baking mix and water to a soft dough; knead 5 times on floured cloth-covered board.  Roll into rectangle, 15x10 inches.  Spread with tuna mixture.

Roll up, beginning at long side.  With sealed edge down, shape into ring on greased baking sheet; pinch ends together.  With paring knife, make cuts 2/3 of the way through ring at 1- inch intervals.  Turn each section on its side to show filling.  Brush top with reserved egg.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve with hot cheese sauce.

Cheese sauce-Melt 2 tablespoons butter in microwave, stir in 2 tablespoons flour.  Then add 1 cup milk, stir well.  Place in microwave and cook stirring every 30 seconds.  When thick season with salt, pepper, then add grated sharp cheese till it taste the way you want.  I usually add about 3/4 cup cheese.

ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp minced rosemary or 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary

ingredients.name: grated fresh Parmesan cheese
ingredients.display_text: 6 tbsp grated fresh Parmesan cheese ((this is about 1.5 ounces))

recipes.instructions:
Heat 2 Tb of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion brown until clear, then add the garlic and stir until both are brown. Don't burn the garlic! Stir in 4 c water, 1 ts rosemary, ¾ ts sea salt, ¼ pepper, 3 cans chickpeas (drained) and 1 can tomatoes (not drained). Bring all of it to a boil, reduce heat, and then simmer for 20 minutes.
Take soup off heat. Puree the soup. I love my hand held Cuisinart mixer (which I got for my birthday from Sus! Thank you) which purees everything to a creamy texture in 3 minutes! You can also blend it by cupping half the soup in a blender, blending it, and then saving it in another bowl until it is all pureed.
Finally, bring all of the soup back into the pot. Stir in balsamic vinegar and bring to a boil. Place soup in bowls and garnish each bowl with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese. YUM!

recipes.title: Zucchini Risotto

ingredients.prep_notes: freshly ground black pepper to taste

recipes.instructions:
1. Bring vegetable or chicken stock to a boil in a medium stock pot, then reduce heat to a low simmer.
   2. Melt butter in a large, heavy bottomed stock pot over medium heat. Stir in onions and cook for 2 minutes, or until softened. Add the rice and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted. Gradually ladle in simmering vegetable stock, stirring continuously. Risotto will become "creamy" and slightly sticky, yet still firm in the center, or al dente.
   3. When almost finished, stir in the zucchini, sun-dried tomatoes, and thyme, adding stock as needed and stirring continuously. Stir in basil and 3 tablespoons cheese just before serving. Divide risotto among 6 bowls, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and season with pepper to taste.
